text.body:
kapilapurāṇam
atha prathamo'dhyāyaḥ pāntu vo jaladaśyāmāḥ śārṅgajyāghātakarkaśāḥ trailokyamaṇḍapastambhāścatvāro haribāhavaḥ ||1|| śalyajiduvāca mayā śrutāni kṣetrāṇi puṇyānyaghaharāṇi ca idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi kṣetrāṇyutkaladeśake ||2|| teṣu kṣetreṣu yatpuṇyaṃ yattīrthaṃ yāśca devatāḥ yadāśrayaṃ ca mānyāṃstān sarvān tvaṃ kathaya tvayam ||3|| tvatprasādādbhaviṣyāmi kṛtārtho'haṃ mahāmune sarvābhirdevatābhistvaṃ vandyaḥ pūjyatamaḥ prabho ||4|| tvaṃ hi sarvāṇi jānāsi purāṇāṣṭadaśāni ca sarvaśāstrāṇi jānāsi sarvajñastvaṃ mahāmune ||5|| kapila uvāca kathayāmi rahasyaṃ tvāṃ śṛṇuṣvaikamanā nṛpa yeṣāṃ smaraṇamātreṇa kalmaṣā yānti vai kṣayam ||6|| varṣāṇāṃ bhārataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ deśānāmutkalaḥ smṛtaḥ utkalena samo deśo deśo nāsti mahītale ||7|| atraivodāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ṛṣīṇāṃ caiva samvādaṃ bhāradvājena dhīmatā ||8|| puṣkare ca vane puṇye tiṣṭhanto munipuṅgavāḥ bharadvājamidaṃ procuste sarve ca hatāṃhasaḥ ||9|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ yasminpuṇyavane vidvan yat puṇyaṃ samudāhṛtam pāpānāṃ caiva yad bhogyaṃ tat sarvaṃ kathayasva naḥ ||10|| bharadvāja uvāca asmin puṇyavane viprā ye vasanti narottamāḥ teṣāṃ bhāgyaṃ mahajjanma saphalaṃ gīyate dvijaiḥ ||11|| puṣkare'smin vane viprā ye'rcayanti janārdanam sarvapāpakṣayaṃ kṛtvā hareḥ padamavāpnuyuḥ ||12|| atra ye sthātumicchanti vītarāgā vikalmaṣāḥ teṣāṃ bhāgyavatāṃ pitroḥ saphalaṃ jīvanaṃ śrutam ||13|| ye'tra dānaṃ dvijātibhyaḥ prayacchanti subhaktitaḥ te svargalokamāsādya na tyajanti kadācana ||14|| svalpapuṇyaṃ bahutaraṃ bhavatyatra tapodhanāḥ devatāḥ sthātumicchanti anyeṣāṃ kā kathā dvijāḥ ||15|| svapantyatra tu ye te vai praṇamanti janārdanam bhojanaṃ kurvate ye'tra ye yajanti maheśvaram ||16|| evamādiguṇāścāsya puṣkarasya tapodhanāḥ atra prāṇān parityajya gatāḥ svargaṃ narottamāḥ ||17|| etat puṇyatamaṃ tīrthaṃ vanānāmuttamaṃ śrutam devatābhiḥ samājuṣṭaṃ puṇyatīrthairabhiṣṭutam ||18|| vakulaiścampakairvakṣairdāḍimairatiśobhitaiḥ aśokaiścaiva punnāgaiḥ karṇikāraiśca pāṭalaiḥ ||19|| pūgaiḥ pānasakairvṛkṣairnārikelaiśca kharjuraiḥ sālatālatamālaiśca vaṭairaśvatthakaistathā ||20|| evaṃ nānāvidhairvṛkṣaiḥ pūritaṃ tat samantataḥ mallījātīsamāyuktaṃ kundapuṣpaistu śobhitam ||21|| tulasīdalakairyuktaṃ pavitraṃ pāpanāśanam atra pāpaṃ tu kurvanti ye narā mohasaṃyutāḥ ||22|| na teṣāṃ tu punarjanma bhavedvai bhāratottame aṇumātramayaṃ cātra bhavedvai parvatopamam ||23|| atra pratigrahaṃ ghoraṃ hālāhalaviṣopamam anya kṣetreṣu yatpuṇyaṃ tadapyatra kṣayaṃ bhavet ||24|| īṣatpāpaṃ bhaveccātra merutulyaṃ mahīsurāḥ etasmātkāraṇādviprā yadicchatha parāṃ gatim ||25|| pāpāni ca parityajya puṇyaṃ tatra samācara iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā munayaḥ puṇyalālasāḥ ||26|| ūcuste ghanagambhīraṃ bhāradvājaṃ mahadvacaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ duṣkaraṃ tatra puṇyaṃ vai bhāradvāja mahāmate ||27|| pāpaṃ puṇyatamaṃ yatra tatsthānaṃ vada naḥ prabho bharadvāja uvāca imamarthaṃ mayā pṛṣṭaḥ kuśaketuḥ purā dvijāḥ ||28|| sa yadāha śṛṇudhvaṃ tadbhavapāpavimocanam deśānāṃ pravaro hyeka oḍradeśo'tiviśrutaḥ ||29|| puṇyāyante ca pāpāni tatra deśe parantapāḥ puṇyakṣetrāṇi tīrthāni tatra santi maharṣayaḥ ||30|| alpapuṇyaṃ bahutaraṃ bhavettatra na saṃśayaḥ tasmātkṣetramidaṃ viprāḥ sevanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ ||31|| iti śrīkapilapurāṇe ṛṣipraśno nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ ||1||
atha dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ oḍradeśasya māhātmyaṃ samākhyāhi savistaram yāsyāmastaṃ vayaṃ deśaṃ tiṣṭhāmastatra deśake ||1|| bharadvāja uvāca sarvapāpaharaṃ deśamoḍraṃ devaistu kalpitam śṛṇudhvaṃ kathyamānaṃ hi vistareṇāsya bho dvijāḥ ||2|| tasminnoḍre sadā santi kṛṣṇārkapārvatīharāḥ evamīśasya kṣetraṃ tu sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ||3|| tatra deśe dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ nadīnāmuttamā nadī mahānadīti vikhyātā sarvapāpāpanodinī ||4|| tasyā nadyāstu māhātmyaṃ kathayāmi punaḥ punaḥ tasyāṃ snātvā naraśreṣṭho divyalokaṃ samāpnuyāt ||5|| purā tretāyuge vipraḥ sukāntināmataḥ śrutaḥ brāhmaṇaḥ sarvaśāstrajño nītijñaḥ pulahātmajaḥ ||6|| mahendre parvate tiṣṭhan sa prāha pitaraṃ dvijaḥ sukāntiruvāca etatsthānaṃ janākīrṇaṃ babhūva hi tataḥ prabho ||7|| tapaścartuṃ mahāraṇyaṃ prayātuṃ kathayasva mām pulaha uvāca sarvavyaktiparityaktaṃ sarvapakṣisukhāvaham ||8|| mṛgānekaiḥ samākīrṇaṃ siddhairgandharvasevitam tapasastu mahat sthānaṃ vidvadbhiḥ parikīrtitam ||9|| vraja tvaṃ sumanā bhūtvā suphalaṃ vindhyaparvatam pitṛvākyamidaṃ śrutvā sukāntiḥ sahasā yayau ||10|| phaladaṃ sarvapuṇyānāṃ śubhadaṃ tapase budhāḥ gatvā ca dṛṣṭavān sthānaṃ tapase nirjanaṃ mahat ||11|| tapo'tra ca kariṣyāmi manasedaṃ vicāryyavān tatrādṛṣṭvā ca salilaṃ salilārthaṃ tapo'karot ||12|| āyāhi nimnage devi saricchreṣṭhe'mbudhipriye tapo'trāhaṃ kariṣyāmi mayi gaṅge kṛpāṃ kuru ||13|| japtvedaṃ paramaṃ mantraṃ sarvasiddhimavāpa ha mantrasyāsya prasādena viprasya tapasastathā ||14|| sarvapāpaharā tatra gaṅgā avatatāra ha gaṅgovāca sādhu putra mahābhāga tapastaptaṃ tvayā mahat ||15|| tvadarthamājagāmāhaṃ vindhyaṃ śailaṃ nagottamam idānīṃ svecchayā vipra tvaṃ kuruṣva tapo mahat ||16|| tāvadatra tu tiṣṭhāmi yāvatte tapasaḥ phalam vindhyādasmādgamiṣyāmi paścācca pūrvasāgaram ||17|| idānīmatra tiṣṭhāmi tapase'rthe tavātra ca devānāṃ durlabhā cāhaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ ca kā kathā ||18|| prāptā'haṃ ca tvayā brahman pulahasya prabhāvataḥ bharadvāja uvāca gaṅgāyā vacanaṃ śrutvā prītātmā pulahātmajaḥ uvāca ghanagambhīraṃ vacanaṃ jāhnavīṃ dvijāḥ ||19|| bhūtanāthasya devasya priyā tvaṃ cakrapāṇinaḥ brahmaṇaśca priyā tvaṃ hi sarveṣāṃ caiva durlabhā ||20|| brahmalokātpurā jātā tasmācchaṃkaramūrdhani tasmādvahasi medinyāṃ prāṇināṃ hitakāraṇāt ||21|| jāhnavīmidamuktvā tu kṛtāñjalipuṭo'grataḥ prapanno hi dvijaśreṣṭhaḥ stutimenāṃ cakāra ha ||22|| sukāntiruvāca namāmi devīṃ pāpaghnīṃ jāhnavīṃ bhaktavatsalām trailokyapāvanī tvaṃ hi rakṣa māṃ śaraṇāgatam ||23|| sarvapāpakṣayakarī sarvalokārtināśinī pūjyā tvaṃ sarvadaivaistu tvāṃ nato'smi punaḥ punaḥ ||24|| girijānāthaśirasi sthitā tvaṃ janabhāvinī tvāṃ nato'smi sthitāṃ gaṅgāṃ pitāmahakamaṃḍalau ||25|| viṣṇoḥ pādābjajāṃ tvāṃ hi bhagīrathavarapradām praṇato'smi mahābhāgāṃ tāriṇīṃ sagarātmajān ||26|| iti śrutvā stutiṃ viprāḥ papāta dharaṇītale atha gaṅgā mahāpuṇyā dṛṣṭvā bhaktiṃ dvijasya ca ||27|| vipramuttolayāmāsa bāhubhyāṃ patitāṃ bhuvi mukhe tu cumbanaṃ datvā mārjayitvā tanoḥ rajaḥ ||28|| kroḍe niveśayāmāsa uvāca madhuraṃ vacaḥ gaṅgovāca putrastvaṃ me mahābhāga dharmato nātra saṃśayaḥ ||27|| tavādyā'pi ca mātā'haṃ varaṃ varaya suvrata sukāntiruvāca yaduktaṃ hi tvayā pūrvaṃ gantā'smi pūrvasāgaram idānīṃ gaccha tvaṃ mātarmama kīrtiḥ sadāstu vai ||30|| aparaṃ varamicchāmi prapannāya pradīyatām bhavatu tatra sampūrṇaṃ tapo me vibhavārjitam ||31|| gaṅgovāca evamastu mahābhāga tapaste vibhavārjitam svanāmnā cātra vikhyātiṃ na gantāsmi dvijottama ||32|| mahānadīti vikhyātiṃ gamiṣyāmyatra sarvadā bhagīrathena cānītā yathārthaṃ pāpanāśinī ||33|| tasmācchataguṇā proktā yatrāhaṃ duritāpahā sarvadā tava kīrtistu sthāsyatyatra mahītale ||34|| bharadvāja uvāca iti dattvā varaṃ tasmai gaṅgā trailokyapāvanī dhṛtvāmbuvigrahaṃ sā ca vavāha pūrvasāgaram ||35|| mahānadī mahāpuṇyā mahādevapriyā śubhā dvitīyaṃ vigrahaṃ dhṛtvā āste gaṅgā tu yā yayā ||36|| utkaleśaṃ samāsādya yāvaccitrā maheśvarī tāvaccitrotpalākhyātā sarvapuṇyapradāyinī ||37|| mahānadyāṃ naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā vai pārvatīharam sarvapāpavinirmukto gaṅgāsnānaphalaṃ labhet ||38|| iti śrīkapilapurāṇe mahānadīmāhātmyaṃ nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||2||
atha tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ purā te kathitā vipra kṛṣṇārkapārvatīharāḥ teṣāṃ kṣetraṃ ca tīrthaṃ ca kathayasva yathārthataḥ ||1|| bharadvāja uvāca ādau kṛṣṇasya māhātmyaṃ māhātmyaṃ kṣetratīrthayoḥ saṃkṣepeṇa pravakṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ bho dvijottamāḥ ||2|| kṣetraṃ nīlācalaṃ puṇyaṃ dārubrahmasvarūpiṇaḥ atra kṣetre tyajan dehaṃ naro vaikuṇṭhamāpnuyāt ||3|| nīlācalaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ varadāya priyaṃ mahat daśayojanavistīrṇamucchṛtaṃ yojanārddhakam ||4|| nānāmunigaṇākīrṇaṃ vihaṅgairupaśobhitam pādapaiḥ saphalairyuktaṃ puṣpairnānā vidhairapi ||5|| sākṣādvaikuṇṭharūpaṃ tatkṣetraṃ śrīpuruṣottamam kṣetrāṇāmapi kṣetraṃ yat tīrthānāmapi yadvaram ||6|| nidrā samādhisatkarmaparamānandanirvṛtiḥ sarvakarmāṇi dharmāṇi dhanyāni puruṣottame ||7|| yasmin kṣetre sadā santi brahmahatyāvatāragāḥ jagannāthaṃ ca paśyanti snātvā tīrthamahodadhau ||8|| nīlācalavare viprāḥ purā nīlāśmarūpadhṛk idānīṃ tu jagannātho bhāti dāravanīlayā ||9|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ purā kathaṃ bharadvājo devadevo jagatpatiḥ nīlāśmāṅgastu nīlādrau sāmprataṃ ca kathaṃ pṛthak ||10|| bharadvāja uvāca saṃkṣepeṇa pravakṣyāmi tāṃ kathāṃ vai sanātanīm yāṃśca śrutvā punarmohaṃ naiva gacchanti mānavāḥ ||11|| āsītsatyayuge viprā indra dyumno mahīpatiḥ sa vai kṣīrasamudre ndusamaḥ śatrukulāntakaḥ ||12|| devadeve jagannāthe bhaktiryasya dṛḍhā matā yastu sākṣāt svayaṃ viprā brāhmaṇaḥ pañcamastanuḥ ||13|| yadā śrībhagavān śaṃbhurgṛhṇātisma himādri jām tadā jaghāna sahasā brahmaṇaḥ pañcamaṃ śiraḥ ||14|| tadā prabhṛti bho viprā brahmā caiva caturmukhaḥ chinnaśirā mahābāhurindra dyumneti viśrutaḥ ||15|| yajvā tapasvī dāntastu śāntaścātithipūjakaḥ vaiṣṇavaḥ satyasampanno jitakrodho jitendri yaḥ ||16|| evameṣa mahīpālaḥ cintayāmāsa cetasi viṣṇuṃ jiṣṇuṃ caturbāhuṃ locanābhyāṃ pivāmyaham ||17|| itthaṃ cintayatastasya mahīpālasya bho dvijāḥ svapne tu darśanaṃ dattvā viṣṇuścedaṃ vaco'bravīt ||18|| śrībhagavān uvāca indra dyumna mahīpāla śṛṇu madvacanaṃ hitam yacchrutvā tvaṃ punarmohaṃ naiva yāsyasi suvrata ||19|| lavaṇasyodadhestīre bālukābhiḥ samāvṛte tatra nīlācalaṃ kṣetraṃ mama tiṣṭhati muktidam ||20|| rahasyaṃ durlabhaṃ sthānaṃ sthalaṃ brahmādidurlabham yogino vītarāgāśca na jānanti mama sthalam ||21|| gopyaṃ puṇyapradaṃ kṣetraṃ matpūjyaṃ puruṣottamam pralaye ca mahīpāla naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame ||22|| viśve'smin duḥkhite caiva kāruṇyakajalāplute mahatkṣetrāṇi puṇyāni tīrthānyāyatanāni ca ||23|| āśramāṇi ca ramyāṇi vaikuṇṭhakṣīrasāgaram etāni saṃparityajya susthānāni mahīpate ||24|| vaṭapatrapuṭastho'hamasmi śrīpuruṣottame tatra gaccha mahīpāla prayatnena susaṃyataḥ ||25|| dra kṣyate tvaṃ tapastaptvā indra nīlatanuṃ hi mām ||26|| rohiṇyākhyaṃ mahattīrthaṃ matpārśve caiva tiṣṭhati tatra bhaktyā naraḥ snātvā maddehe līyate dhruvam ||27|| evaṃ nigadite tasmin keśave keśisūdane indra dyumnasya rājarṣeḥ svayaṃ nidrā babhaṃja ha ||28|| tataḥ suptotthito rājā na dṛṣṭvā śyāmasundaram ruroda bhṛśaduḥkhārtaḥ kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeti kīrtayan ||29|| devānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca kiṃ mayāpakṛtaṃ kṛtam paśyato me gataḥ kutra ghanaśyāmo nirañjanaḥ ||30|| jalārthamāgatā gāvaḥ kiṃ me niyamitāḥ purā paśyato me gataḥ kutra śaṅkhacakradharo hariḥ ||31|| cūtanimbakadambādyāḥ pādapāśchāditā mayā paśyato me gataḥ kutra pītavāsā gadādharaḥ ||32|| vaiśvadevasya velāyāṃ nārcitaścātithirmayā paśyato me devadevo gataḥ kutra jagatpatiḥ ||33|| paranindā kṛtā kiṃ me vastraṃ cāpi hṛtaṃ mayā paśyato me gataḥ kutra sindhujāratidāyakaḥ ||34|| mayā hatā brāhmaṇāśca gāvaḥ kiṃ vā sahasraśaḥ paśyato me gataḥ kutra śaṃkarārddhaśarīrakaḥ ||35|| kiṃ me na rakṣitāḥ śīghraṃ prajā duḥkhapariplutāḥ paśyato me gataḥ kutra rāghavo rāvaṇāntakaḥ ||36|| kiṃ me loṣṭhaṃ tṛṇaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ kṣiptaṃ kūpe jalāśaye paśyato me gataḥ kutra tena pāpena keśihā ||37|| sabhyāḥ kiṃ nārcitāḥ kāle tarpaṇaṃ na kṛtaṃ mayā paśyato me gataḥ kutra gopikānandavarddhanaḥ ||38|| itthaṃ vilapatastasya indra dyumnasya dhīmataḥ āyayurmantriṇaḥ paurā śrīmantaśca purohitāḥ ||39|| te dṛṣṭvā rodanaṃ tasya indra dyumnasya bhūpateḥ procuritthaṃ vacaḥ sarve bhṛśaṃ duḥkhitamānasāḥ ||41|| mantriṇa ūcuḥ mahīpate mahābāho kimarthaṃ ruditaṃ tvayā kathayasva yathārthaṃ naḥ sādhayāmo na saṃśayaḥ ||42|| itthamārādhito bhūyo mantribhiśca purohitaiḥ tānuvāca prayatnena harṣagadgadayā girā ||43|| indra dyumna uvāca svapne dṛṣṭo jagannāthaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ vanamālī pītavāsā dhanaśyāmo ramāpatiḥ ||44|| sa uvāca hṛṣīkeśo māṃ svapnapāpakāriṇam gaccha bhūpa tapastaptvā dra kṣyase nīlaparvate ||45|| idānīṃ ca gamiṣyāmi nīlādriṃ nirmalapradam kurudhvaṃ mantriṇo'dīrghaṃ saṃbhāraṃ mama sammatam ||46|| svīkṛtya sarvapaurāśca mantriṇaśca purohitāḥ āviveśa tato rājā yayuḥ svaṃ svaṃ puraṃ tataḥ ||46|| bharadvāja uvāca etasminnantare viprā yamastu ravinandanaḥ tatkṣaṇe hṛtakāmastu nīlaparvatamāviśat ||48|| duḥkhito yamunābhrātā vepamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ sthitvāgre vāsudevasya vākyametaduvāca ha ||49|| yama uvāca namo'stu viṣṇave tubhyaṃ sarvalokahitātmane rajastamovimuktastvaṃ svaprakāśa namo'stu te ||50|| sṛṣṭo'haṃ pretarājaste devadeva jagatpate kiṃ karomi mahābāho tvaṃ vai dīnārtanāśanaḥ ||51|| śrībhagavān uvāca kiṃ te duḥkhaṃ samutpannaṃ kathayasva mamāgrataḥ taṃ duḥkhaṃ chedayiṣyāmi satyaṃ ca ravinandana ||52|| yama uvāca kṛtaṃ deva tvayā satyamidānīṃ kathayāmyaham tatkuruṣva mahābāho śṛṇuṣva madhusūdana ||53|| indra dyumnastu nṛpatirāgacchati balānvitaḥ muktiṃ yāsyanti te sarve kiṃ karomi vada prabho ||53|| parityajya jagannāthaṃ nīlendrā nilāṅgagam pātālaṃ yātu tattīrthaṃ rohi yākhyaṃ ca keśava ||54|| yasmin snātvā mahābāho kāko muktimavāpa ha yadrū paṃ ca samālokya śavo'pi cājarāmaraḥ ||56|| śrībhagavān uvāca satyamuktaṃ tvayā pūrvamidānīṃ kiṃ karomyaham yaduktaṃ te vacaḥ sarvamevaṃ bhavatu bhāskare ||57|| viśvakarmā tataḥ śīghraṃ pratimātrayamakalpayat bharadvāja uvāca ajñāṃ prāpya jagannāthātsvagṛhaṃ bhāskariryayau devadevo'pi bhagavānnāste nīlācale śubhe ||58|| iti śrīkapilapurāṇe yamavaradānaṃ nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||3||
atha caturtho'dhyāyaḥ nīlaśaile jagannāthaṃ mantribhiḥ saha bhūmipaḥ purohitaiḥ purāṇajñaiḥ prajābhiścaiva vāraṇaiḥ ||1|| gacchan mārge dadarśātha vanaikāgre śirottamam pūjayitvā ca te natvā gatavān nīlaparvatam ||2|| svarṇakūṭātparaṃ nīlaśailo hi bhuvi rājate etya tatra dadarśāsau śaṅkhacakragadādharam ||3|| samīpaṃ tasya saṃprāpya rājāsau dīnamānasaḥ karaṃ saṃpuṭikāṃ baddhvā nāradaṃ paryapṛcchat ||4|| indra dyumna uvāca sphurate dakṣiṇaṃ cakṣurvāmāṅgaṃ tu prakampate mamaitatkāraṇaṃ brūhi trikālajñastvameva hi ||5|| nārada uvāca indra dyumna mahābāho indra nīlatanurhariḥ pātālaṃ gatavānadya rohiṇyākhyaṃ gatastathā ||6|| indra dyumnastu tacchrutvā vajrapātasamaṃ vacaḥ papāta dharaṇīpṛṣṭhe gireḥ śṛṅgamivāparam ||7|| taṃ dṛṣṭvā duḥkhitāḥ sarve mantriṇaśca purohitāḥ śīghramunnāmayāmāsurnṛpatiṃ patitaṃ bhuvi ||8|| etasminnantare viprāḥ nārado munipuṅgavaḥ uvāca vacanaṃ ramyaṃ rājānaṃ dīnamānasam ||9|| nārada uvāca brahmaṇā preṣito'haṃ ca tavānte nātra saṃśayaḥ idānīṃ tu jagannāthaḥ punassthānaṃ kariṣyati ||10|| ityukte nāradenaiva cakruḥ kolāhalaṃ janāḥ śaṅkhacakrāṅkitatanurdārurutplavate dvijāḥ ||11|| janānāṃ tadvacaḥ śrutvā sa nṛpo harṣamānasaḥ tapodhanaṃ kare dhṛtvā kṛtāñjalipuṭo'grataḥ ||12|| rājovāca namaste brahmaṇe tubhyaṃ ballakīpāṇaye namaḥ gatvā dṛṣṭvā samānīto dārū rājā janaiḥ saha ||13|| valabhadro jagannāthaḥ subhadrā ca sudarśanam ||14|| vanamālī pītavāsāḥ śaṅkhacakradharo hariḥ halapāṇiḥ gadāpāṇirbalabhadro balānvitaḥ ||15|| subhadrā padmahastā ca stambharūpaṃ sudarśanam etāśca pratimāḥ kṛtvā sthāpayitvātra maṇḍape ||16|| brahmalokaṃ mahābāhuḥ pratiṣṭhārthaṃ samāyayau gatvā ca dṛṣṭavāṃstatra brahmā hi kuśalāñchanam ||17|| uvāca vacanaṃ natvā kṛtāñjalipuṭo'grataḥ namaste brahmaṇe tubhyaṃ prajānāṃ pataye namaḥ trāhi māṃ karuṇāgāra pūrayasva manoratham ||18|| brahmovāca sādhu putra mahābāho vaiṣṇavastvādṛśo bhuvi nātīto vartamānaśca na bhaviṣyati me matiḥ ||19|| adhunā'haṃ gamiṣyāmi tavārthaṃ cakrapāṇinaḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ ca kariṣyāmi gaccha śīghraṃ mahīpate ||20|| bharadvāja uvāca brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā rājā hṛṣṭamanā bhavat brahmalokātparibhraṣṭo bhūmilokaṃ samāviśat ||21|| āgatya dṛṣṭavāṃstatra gaṇaṃ nṛpatikuñjaram vigṛhya tena rājendro jagrāha harimavyayam ||22|| tato brahmā brahmalokādbhūmilokaṃ samāviśat āgatya kṣipraṃ bhūlokaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ kṛtavāṃstataḥ ||23|| jitaṃ ta iti mantreṇa astuvan devatāgaṇāḥ āvirbabhūva bhagavān śaṅkhacakradharo hariḥ ||24|| prīto viṣṇuruvācedamindra dyumnaṃ mahīpatim śrībhagavānuvāca puṇyakṣetrāṇi tīrthāni parityajya mahīpate atraiva sarvabhāvena sthāsye'haṃ vai parārddhakam ||25|| indra dyumna mahīpāla śṛṇu madvacanaṃ hitam snānaṃ tvaṃ ca prakurvīthā guḍicākhyaṃ mahotsavam ||26|| snānakāle narā ye māṃ dra kṣyanti ca mudānvitāḥ sarvapāpavinirmuktāste yānti bhuvanaṃ mama ||27|| tūṣṇīṃ babhūva bhagavānidamuktvā janārdanaḥ brahmāpi brahmalokaṃ ca gatavān bho dvijottamāḥ ||28|| indra dyumno hi rājarṣirdevadevaṃ jagatpatim pūjayitvā prayatnena tato muktimavāpa saḥ ||29|| evaṃ purā jagannātha indra nīlasvarūpadhṛk dārubrahmasvarūpeṇa bhātīdānīṃ jagatpatiḥ ||30|| iti śrīkapilapurāṇe indra dyumnanṛpamokṣaprāptirnāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ ||4||
atha pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ bhāradvāja uvāca tasmin kṣetre dvijaśreṣṭhā ye vasanti narāḥ kila te yānti viṣṇoḥ sānnidhyaṃ bhāsamānāḥ sutejasaḥ ||1|| mahodadhau naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā śrīpuruṣottamam brahmahatyādipāpāni kṣayitvā mokṣamāpnuyāt ||2|| gaṅgāyātrāsarasvatyāḥ godāvaryyāśca bho dvijāḥ yattatphalamavāpnoti acalāmbudhidarśanāt ||3|| mārkaṇḍeyaṃ ca tatraiva tīrthaṃ trailokyapāvanam yatra snātvā surāḥ sarve svapadaṃ prāpnuyuḥ purā ||4|| mārkaṇḍeyavaṭaṃ viprāḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇena nirmitam hitārthaṃ ca maharṣīṇāṃ mārkaṇḍeyasya dhīmataḥ ||5|| yatra snātvā naraśreṣṭho dṛṣṭvā śailasutāpatim koṭijanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva nāśayet ||6|| tasmānnīlācale viprā devarājasya dakṣiṇe yameśvara iti khyāto yamasaṃyamatatparaḥ ||7|| yameśvaraṃ samālokya pūjayitvā ca bhaktitaḥ naraḥ śivamavāpnoti yamadaṇḍavivarjitaḥ ||8|| tasyāḥ paścimadigbhāge'lāvunāthasaṃjñakaḥ samāśritya narastaṃ ca manorathamavāpnuyāt ||9|| aputraḥ putravāṃścaiva vyaṅgaḥ kandarparūpadhṛk bhavatyevaṃ mahīpāla tasya liṅgasya sevanāt ||10|| kapālamocanaṃ nāma liṅgaṃ sannihitaṃ prabhoḥ taddṛṣṭvāvidhivadbhaktyā brahmahatyādvimucyate ||11|| bhakṣaṇāddarśanāccaiva dvijātīnāṃ vimuktidam dvijāśca supacāyānnaṃ yatra bhuñjannapūpakam ||12|| tasmātsarvaprayatnena gantavyaḥ puruṣottamaḥ dra ṣṭavyaśca jagannātha ātmano muktikāraṇāt ||13|| vaṭamūle vaṭeśaśca sarvapāpapraṇāśanaḥ tasya darśanamātreṇa sarvapāpādvimucyate ||14|| vārāṇasyā samaṃ hyasti kṣetramekaṃ na kiṃcana puruṣākhyasamaṃ kṣetraṃ nāsti trailokyamaṇḍale ||15|| sarveṣāṃ caiva kṣetrāṇāṃ rājā śrīpuruṣottamaḥ devānāmapi sarveṣāmuttamaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||16|| kiṃ cātra bahunoktena bhāṣitena punaḥ punaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ kṣetraṃ na puruṣottamāt ||17|| puruṣottamamāhātmyaṃ vaktuṃ varṣaśatairapi na samartho dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ kimanyacchrotumarhatha ||18|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ samyak proktaṃ tvayā kṣetraṃ muktidaṃ puruṣottamam kathayasva tasmin kṣetre kiṃ kartavyaṃ dvijottamāḥ ||19|| pūrvamuktaṃ tvayā viprā yameśo muktidāyakaḥ indrā didevatāḥ sarve tatra santi tapasvinaḥ ||20|| īṣat puṇyaṃ bhavettatra merutulyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ kurudhvaṃ tatra bho viprāstapo muktipradāyakam ||21|| bharadvāja uvāja tatsthānaṃ sumahatpuṇyaṃ devādīnāṃ ca durlabham bahupuṇyena devāśca tatra santi maharṣayaḥ ||22|| nānāpuṣpasamāyuktaṃ yūpavṛkṣavirājitam punnāgairnārikelaiśca pūritaṃ tat samantataḥ ||23|| karavīraiḥ karṇikāraiśca pādapaiścampakaistathā mallikāyūthikābhiśca jātibhiḥ paripūritam ||24|| tapasastu mahatsthānaṃ munīndraiḥ parikīrtitam ye yajanti narāstatra śāntāste pūtamānasāḥ ||25|| yameśvaraprasādena mantrasiddhimavāpnuyuḥ evaṃ śrīpuruṣākhyasya mahātmyaṃ gaditaṃ mayā ||26|| iti śrīkapilapurāṇe puruṣottamamahātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ ||5||
atha ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ purā te gaditā viprāḥ kṛṣṇārkapārvatīharāḥ idānīṃ bhāskarasyeha māhātmyaṃ vada naḥ prabho ||1|| bharadvāja uvāca kathayāmi rahasyaṃ vo pāvanaṃ kṣetramuttamam yatra gatvā purā viprāḥ śāmbaḥ kuṣṭānmumoca ha ||2|| ṛṣayaḥ ūcuḥ kutaḥ samāgataḥ śāmbaḥ kamārādhya mumoca ha kimarthaṃ tasya dehe ca vada kuṣṭaṃ babhūva ha ||3|| bharadvāja uvāca duṣṭānāṃ vigrahārthāya śiṣṭānāṃ pālanāya ca dvāpare kṛṣṇavane viprāḥ śvetagaṅgeti viśrutā ||4|| śvetamādhavarūpeṇa tatrāste bhagavān prabhuḥ matsyamādhavastatraiva vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ ubhayordṛṣṭiyogena kīṭo muktimavāpnuyāt ||5|| brahmahā ca surāpaśca goghno vāpi ca ghātakaḥ te sarve muktimāyānti madhye ca śvetamatsyayoḥ ||6|| śvetāyāṃ ca naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā ca śvetamatsyakau pāpāni ca parityajya śvetadvīpaṃ vrajet dhruvam ||7|| indra dyumnasarastatra indre ṇa samapūjitam tatra sākṣānnaro viprā indre ṇa saha modate ||8|| tatrasthaṃ narasiṃhaṃ ca śaṅkaraṃ nīlakandharam dṛṣṭvā natvā pūjayitvā jyotirlokaṃ vrajennaraḥ ||9|| hariśaṅkarayormadhye yo dadyātpiṇḍamuttamam pitṝṇāmuddhṛtiṃ kṛtvā ravilokaṃ vrajennaraḥ ||10|| puṇyaṃ kalpavaṭaṃ tatra dārubrahmasamīpataḥ yasya chāyāṃ samākramya brahmahatyād vimucyate ||11|| kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ tasya yastu taṃ pūjayet vaṭam tasya janmaśatordbhūtaṃ doṣaṃ ca kṣamate hariḥ ||12|| maṅgalāvaṭamūle ca devīmaṅgaladāyinī tāṃ dṛṣṭvā pūjayitvā ca mohabandhādvimucyate ||13|| vaṭasya paścime bhāge vimalā vimalapradā tasyā darśanamātreṇa vidyāvān jāyate naraḥ ||14|| tadagre narasiṃhastu koṭisūryyasamaprabhaḥ daityendro 'pi ca tatrāste darśanānmuktido mataḥ ||15|| tasyāgre vāsudevaśca śeṣaśāyī gadādharaḥ śaṅkhacakrāṅkito bhūtvā vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ ||16|| kṣīraśāyī jagannāthaḥ sākṣādatra sthitaḥ prabhuḥ lakṣmīpādatale cāsti karṇamūle sarasvatī ||17|| nābhipadmopari brahmā vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ kamaṇḍaludharo devaścaturbāhuścaturmukhaḥ ||18|| īśvaraḥ pārvatīnāthaḥ śeṣadehatvamāptavān yasmādabhinnapuruṣastasmādekatvamāptavān ||19|| acalopari deveśaḥ puruṣottamasaṃjñakaḥ virājate vibhuḥ sākṣādanantapuruṣottamaḥ ||20|| puruṣottamanāmaitatkṣetraṃ śrīpuruṣottamam naro muktimavāpyāśu dṛṣṭvā śrīśeṣaśāyinam ||21|| tatra dārusvarūpasya nirmālyaṃ pāpanāśanam annādyapūpakaṃ caiva yadanyat prāpyate param ||22|| jagannāthasya naivedyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam bhakṣaṇātphalamāpnoti kapilākoṭidānajam ||23|| kiṃ tena tanna kṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ kiṃ tena na kṛtaṃ tapaḥ bhakṣitaṃ yena annādyaṃ dārubrahmasvarūpiṇaḥ ||24|| jagannātho yathā sākṣāddarśanānmuktido dhruvam tathaiva muktidaṃ hmannaṃ jagannāthasya bhodvijāḥ ||25|| diśāntaragataṃ vāpi viṣṇustvavatatāra ha so'pi kṛṣṭo jagannātho gopībhiśca samāvṛtaḥ ||26|| bālyakāle sthito gope tataḥ kaṃsaṃ jaghāna ha mathurāyāṃ kṛto rājā ugraseno mahāmanāḥ ||27|| kālanemibhayāttasmānnirgato dvārakāpurīm tasyāṃ sthitaśca śrīkṛṣṇaḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ hitapradaḥ ||28|| yaudhiṣṭhire dharmayajñe gatavān hastināpuram śvetātapatraṃ dattvā sa āgato dvārakāpurīm ||29|| evaṃ palāyatastasya jagannāthasya śārṅgiṇaḥ sutaḥ śāmbo'bhavadviprā dvitīyo ratināyakaḥ ||30|| yathā kṛṣṇastathaivāsau nīlajīmūtasannibhaḥ śaṅkhacakrāṅkitabhujaḥ pītavāsāḥ sulocanaḥ ||31|| jalakrīḍāruciḥ so'tha yoṣidbhiśca samāvṛtaḥ cakrapāṇeravijñāto gato jāmvatīsutaḥ ||32|| taṃ dṛṣṭvā yoṣitaḥ sarvā yayurmohaṃ ca vihvalāḥ tāsāṃ ca skandate retaścakre nindāṃ tadā hariḥ ||33|| dhik ca bhavatu nārīṇāmasatītvaṃ ca dhik pradhik putraṃ dṛṣṭvā kathaṃ sarvā yayurmohaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||34|| tataḥ śāmbamuvācātha īṣatkrodhasamanvitaḥ ||35|| śrībhagavān uvāca mātṝṇāṃ skandate reta āgate tvayi putraka idānīṃ tava dehe ca kuṣṭaṃ bhavatu sarvataḥ ||36|| evaṃ nigadite kṛṣṇe kuṣṭaṃ sarvāṅgakeṣvabhūt śāmbo'pi vepamānaḥ san pitaraṃ vākyamabravīt ||37|| aparādhe kṛte putre kṣamate janakaḥ prabho idānīṃ kiṃ kariṣyāmi śāpamuktiṃ vadasva ha ||38|| bhagavān uvāca maitreyākhyaṃ vanaṃ gatvā tapastaptvā jitendri yaḥ prasādayitvā chāyeśaṃ tato muktiṃ gamiṣyasi ||39|| bharadvāja uvāca iti śrutvā vacastasya śārṅgiṇo rukmiṇīpateḥ ekākī ca jagāmāśu śāmbo duḥkhapariplutaḥ ||40|| gatvā tatra prayatnena tapastepe sudāruṇam śānto dānto nirāhāro vāyubhakṣyo jitendri yaḥ ||41|| śāmbo dvādaśavarṣāṇi sūryyadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ pūjayaṃstu stuvan gāyan sūryasūryeti kīrtayan ||42|| divākara namaste'stu prabhākara namo'stu te trāhi māṃ karuṇāgāra vyaṅgaṃ ca patitaṃ bhūvi ||43|| iti mantraṃ stuvan gāyan śāmbaḥ kṛṣṇātmajo dvijāḥ papāta sahasā bhūmau punaḥ punarudīrayan ||44|| gate ca katicitkāle bhāskaro bhaktavatsalaḥ uvāca vacanaṃ svapne śāpanirmuktakāraṇam ||45|| śrīsūrya uvāca atra tiṣṭha mahābāho darśayāmi svakāṃ tanum tāṃ dṛṣṭvā mucyate rogānnānyathā śṛṇu śāmvaka ||46|| yadā jāmbavatīsūno pāpamuktimapekṣase etāni mama namāni kīrtayasva nirantaram ||47|| bhāskaro bhagavān sūryaścitrabhānurvibhāvasuḥ yamatātaoṃ'śumālī ca yamunāprītidāyakaḥ ||48|| divākaro jagannāthaḥ sarvasākṣī vibhākaraḥ lokacakṣuḥ svayambhūśca chāyāratipradāyakaḥ ||49|| timirārirgrahadharo lokatrayaprakāśakaḥ bhaktabandhurdayāsindhuḥ karmasākṣī parātparaḥ ||50|| ekaviṃśatināmāni yaḥ paṭhedudite mayi tasya śāntiṃ prayacchāmi satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmyaham ||51|| ityuktvā gatavān sūryaḥ śāmbo nidrāṃ ca muktavān tataḥ prabhātasamaye snānārthaṃ prayayau nadīm ||52|| candra bhāgāṃ mahāpuṇyāṃ devalokapradāyinīm tatra gatvā ca sāmbo'sau dvibhujāṃ padmalāñchitām ||53|| pratimāṃ paṅkajasthāṃ ca jalamadhye dadarśa saḥ dṛṣṭvā tāṃ parivṛḍhāṃ ca sareṇāntikamānayat ||54|| mārjayitvā vapustasyāḥ prakṣālya salilena ca gṛhītvā pratimāṃ tāṃ ca yayau śāmbo mahāmatiḥ ||55|| prasādaṃ kārayitvā ca sthāpayāmāsa satvaram tāṃ pūjayitvā vidhivadbhaktyā natvā paraṃ tataḥ ||56|| vimuktarogaḥ sahasā yayau vārāṇasīṃ purīm ||57|| bharadvāja uvāca evaṃ purā gataḥ śāmbastapastatvā divākaram arcayitvā prayatnena tataḥ kuṣṭādvyamucyata ||58|| tatra ye sthātumicchanti vīratarāgā vikalmaṣāḥ teṣāṃ manorathaphalaṃ pūrayedbhagavān raviḥ ||59|| maitreyākhye vane ramye ye tyajanti kalevaram pāpāni ca parityajya jyotirlokaṃ vrajanti te ||60|| ravikṣetre narā ye ca ravivāre samāhitāḥ bhaktyā paśyanti ca raviṃ te gacchanti ravergṛham ||61|| maitreyākhye vane ye ca amṛtāśca punarbhavāḥ devalokaṃ samāsādya raviṇā saha modate ||62|| tatra śrīmaṅgalaṃ tīrthaṃ devānāṃ maṅgalapradam maṅgale ca naraḥ snātvā maṅgalaṃ prāpnuyurdhruvam ||63|| tatra śrīśālmalībhāṇḍaṃ tīrthaṃ trailokyapāvanam sarvapāpaharaṃ guhyaṃ siddhagandharvasevitam ||64|| nānāmunijanākīrṇaṃ sarveṣāṃ muktidāyakam yatra snātvā naraḥ sākṣādra vidīdhitimāpnuyāt ||65|| snātvā śrīśālmalībhāṇḍe dṛṣṭvā chāyāpatiṃ tataḥ aghaughaṃ nāśayitvā ca ādilokaṃ vasennaraḥ ||66|| sūryyagaṅgājale snātvā sūryyalokaṃ vrajennaraḥ sūryyagaṅgāsamaṃ tīrthaṃ nāsti nāsti mahīsurāḥ ||67|| mahodadhau naraḥ snātvā sarvapāpādvimucyate sarvatīrthavaraścāsau sāgaraḥ saritāṃ patiḥ ||68|| rāmeśvarastu tatraiva velāyāṃ ca nadīpateḥ śrīrāmaḥ pūjayāmāsa prāṇināṃ hitakāraṇāt ||69|| rāmeśvaraṃ prayatnena ye'rcayanti narottamāḥ teṣāmiṣṭavaraṃ viprā rāmacandraḥ prayacchati ||70|| gandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca naivedyairye'rcayanti maheśvaram te yānti śivasālokyaṃ viprāstena virājitāḥ ||71|| candra bhāgā jale tatra ye snānti vidhipūrvakam candra tulyavapurdhṛtvā candra lokaṃ vrajanti te ||72|| tatra cārkavaṭo nāma kalpavṛkṣastu tiṣṭhati nānāmunijanākīrṇo vihagairupaśobhitaḥ ||73|| acchedyaścāpyavadhyo'yaṃ vaṭo muktiprado dhruvam prāṇināṃ ca hitārthāya sūryaḥ sākṣācca pādapaḥ ||74|| tatra vṛkṣatale ye ca japanti mantramuttamam tripakṣābhyantare mantraḥ sādhakābhīṣṭasiddhidaḥ ||75|| bhūpāvarkavaṭe viprāḥ svarloke nandanaṃ smṛtam tatra siddhagaṇāḥ santi satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmi vaḥ ||76|| tatra dhyāyanti ye viṣṇuṃ teṣāṃ viṣṇuḥ prasīdati vaṭacchāyāṃ ca ye santi te siddhāśca na saṃśayaḥ ||77|| vijayāṃ daśamīṃ prāpya ye'rcayanti divākaram teṣāṃ vimuktapāpānāṃ sarvatra vijayo bhavet ||78|| maitreyākhye vane puṇye rathayātrāmahotsavam ye paśyanti narā bhaktyā līyante svatanau hareḥ ||79|| evamādiguṇāḥ santi maitreyākhye vanottame na sāmarthyaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ vaktuṃ varṣaśatairapi ||80|| kiṃcitproktaṃ mayā viprā bhavatāṃ hitamuttamam vareṇyaṃ paramaṃ puṇyaṃ kimanyacchrotumarhatha ||81|| iti śrīkapilapurāṇe maitreyavanamāhātmyaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ ||6||
atha saptamo'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ idānīṃ kathayāsmākaṃ pārvatīkṣetramuttamam tatprasādādbhaviṣyāmaḥ kṛtārthā nātra saṃśayaḥ ||1|| bharadvāja uvāca kathayāmi mahāpuṇyaṃ virajākhyaṃ sunirmalam yatkṣetraṃ sṛṣṭirakṣārthaṃ brahmaṇā ca kṛtaṃ purā ||2|| tasmin kṣetre dvijaśreṣṭhā virajā virajapradā virajāmukhamālokya rajaḥprakṣālanaṃ bhavet ||3|| yatra śrīvirajādevī bhuktimuktipradāyinī sādhakānāṃ hitārthāya virajā sā kalau sthitā ||4|| daśavarṣasahasrāṇi yo vā pūjayate haram tatphalaṃ samavāpneti virajā''lokane naraḥ ||5|| kurukṣetre haridvāre yatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti nānyathā bho dvijottamāḥ ||6|| varāharūpo bhagavān tatrāste muktidāyakaḥ taṃ dṛṣṭvā pūjayitvā ca viṣṇulokamavāpnuyāt ||7|| ākhaṇḍalastu tatrāste pārvatīśo jagadguruḥ samālokya prayatnena yamadaṇḍaṃ ca khaṇḍati ||8|| yatrākhaṇḍaladevastu tatra muktirna saṃśayaḥ tatra snātvā ca gacchanti śrīviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam ||9|| ākhaṇḍalaṃ sāmāsādya kuṣṭī kuṣṭāt pramucyate aputrā caiva yā nārī sā dhruvaṃ sutamāpnuyāt ||10|| ākhaṇḍala namastubhyaṃ siddhānāṃ siddhidāyaka akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākārakāraṇāśeṣakāraṇāt ||11|| anena mantrayogena yaḥ paśyet pārvatīpatim sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate ||12|| kroḍākhaṇḍalayormadhye devānāṃ durlabhaprade muktiṃ gacchanti kīṭādyāḥ kiṃ punarmānavā mṛtāḥ ||13|| guruhā brahmahā goghnaḥ surāpo viṣṇunindakaḥ tatra dehaṃ tyajan viprā vaikuṇṭhaṃ labhate dhruvam ||14|| tatra muktīśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ muktidaṃ pāpanāśanam yairdṛṣṭaṃ ca punarviprā yayurmuktiṃ tvarānvitāḥ ||15|| tatra śrīvirajā kṣetre devyā īśānakoṇataḥ gayānābhiḥ mahāpuṇyā pitṝṇāṃ muktidāyikā ||16|| tatra piṇḍaṃ prayacchanti narā ye vītakalmaṣāḥ pitṝnuddhṛtya narakāt te vrajanti padaṃ hareḥ ||17|| tatra vaitaraṇī devī nadī muktipradāyinī gaṅgādevī tvasau viprā satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||18|| vaitaraṇī mahāpuṇyā bhuktidā muktidā nṛṇām mahāpātakakoṭighnī sukṛddarśanamātrataḥ ||19|| tasyāṃ snātvā naraśreṣṭho dṛṣṭvā śrīdaṃṣṭriṇaṃ harim kulakoṭisamāyukto vrajedviṣṇupurīṃ dvijāḥ ||20|| trilocanastu tatrāste bhavapāpavimocanaḥ taṃ dṛṣṭvā vidhivatpūjya trilocanamavāpnuyāt ||21|| trilocanastu bho viprāḥ tāpatrayavibhañjanaḥ trailokyasya hyadhiṣṭhātā taṃ naraḥ ko'pi nāśrayet ||22|| tatra kṣetravare viprāḥ kapilaṃ tīrthamuttamam prasannasalilaṃ caiva manojñaṃ cārudarśanam ||23|| pitṛpakṣe caturdaśyāṃ kāpile snāti yo naraḥ tasya tuṣṭo bhaved viprāḥ śailendra tanayāpatiḥ ||24|| tīrthe kāpilike viprā vidhivatsnāti yo naraḥ kapilākoṭijaṃ puṇyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||25|| tatraiva gograhaṃ tīrthaṃ munīndrai rupasevitam tatra snātvā ca vidhivadgolokasya phalaṃ labhet ||26|| somatīrthavaraṃ cāste nirmitaṃ vai himāṃśunā snātvā tatra naraḥ śreṣṭhaścandra lokaṃ sa gacchati ||27|| tatra bhogānanekāṃśca bhuktvā candra prasādatām bhūmilokaṃ samāsādya rājā bhavati vai dhruvam ||28|| tatra bhaktiṃ samutpādya devadeve maheśvare sarvaṃ pāpaṃ parityajya gacched viṣṇupuraṃ naraḥ ||29|| evaṃ śrīsomatīrthaṃ ca māhātmyaṃ gaditaṃ mayā idānīmadya tīrthāni śṛṇudhvaṃ kathayāmyaham ||30|| kalpāmbusaṃjñakaṃ nāma tatrāste viraje dvijāḥ alpapuṇyaṃ bhavedatra merutulyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||31|| tasminkṣetre purā vṛttaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ dvijasattamāḥ āsītsatyaśca nṛpatirmāndhātā nāma viśrutaḥ ||32|| yajvā'dhvaravare devaṃ dātā bhoktā priyamvadaḥ kṣamāśīlo dayāśīlaḥ satyavāganusūyakaḥ ||33|| mahīpatirasau gacchan nirjane gahane vane mṛgayārthaṃ mahābāhurekākī ca parantapaḥ ||34|| dadarśa vanakhaṇḍe cājagaraṃ lomaharṣaṇam taṃ dṛṣṭvā ghātayāmāsa śareṇaikena dhīmatiḥ ||35|| tasya patnī ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā svapatiṃ patitaṃ bhūvi duḥkhaśokasamāviṣṭā dadau śāpaṃ nṛpāya tam ||36|| adro hakaraṇaṃ krūra matpatiṃ prāṇavallabham jadhnitha tvaṃ yato bhūpa śṛgālatvaṃ tato vraja ||37|| tasyāḥ śāpaprabhāveṇa śṛgālatvaṃ yayau nṛpaḥ gatvā vācamuvācedaṃ sarpapatnīṃ pativratām ||38|| rājovāca śāpamuktiṃ vadāśutvaṃ trāhi māṃ dro hakāraṇam śṛgālavigrahaṃ prāpya jīvataṃ nāsti kāraṇam ||39|| sarpapatnī uvāca yadā tvaṃ ca vaśiṣṭhena virajākhyaṃ gamiṣyasi tasminnanyambutīrthe ca snātvā muktimavāpsyasi ||40|| virajākhyaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha kṣetraṃ paramapāvanam ramyaṃ pāpāpanodaṃ ca svargatulyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||41|| brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyairvaiśyaiḥ samantādabhipūritam nānā devagaṇākīrṇaṃ devadundubhināditam ||42|| tittīḍīśālatālaiśca nārikelaiśca kharjuraiḥ āmrajambūpippalaiśca panasairūpaśobhitam ||43|| pāpānāṃ muktidaṃ bhūpa virajākhyaṃ suniścitam tatraiva tava śāpasya vimuktiśca bhaviṣyati ||44|| tacchrutvā hi śṛgālaśca vepamānaḥ suduḥkhitaḥ vaśiṣṭhasyāśramaṃ gatvā trāhi trāhītyuvāca ha ||45|| śrutvā śāpaṃ ca tadvākyaṃ vaśiṣṭhaḥ paramaṃ tapaḥ āśramāddhi vahirgatvā'bravīdvākyaṃ priyaṃ ca tam ||46|| vaśiṣṭha uvāca trāhīti tvaṃ kathaṃ brūṣe kasmādāgatavāniha kiṃ te ca bhayamutpannaṃ kathayasva mamāgrataḥ ||47|| mṛgayārthaṃ gato'raṇyaṃ māndhātā'haṃ mahīpatiḥ tatra dṛṣṭvā hyajagaraṃ sahasā ca hato mayā ||48|| tato mune pativratayā śapto'haṃ tasya bhāryayā śṛgālo bhava bhūya tvaṃ yattvayā matpatirhataḥ ||49|| kṛpayā ca punaḥ prāha vaśiṣṭhasyāśramaṃ vraja gatvā śrīvirajaṃ tena tato muktiśca labhyate ||50|| idānīṃ trāhi māṃ nātha gacchāvo virajaṃ mune māṃ tatra nītvā kṣipraṃ ca narakāduddhara prabho ||51|| bharadvāja uvāca tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya vaśiṣṭhaḥ karuṇānvitaḥ tena śrīvirajaṃ kṣetraṃ jagāmāśu tapodhanaḥ ||52|| tatra gatvā munīndro 'sau tīrthe kalpāmbusaṃjñake snāpayitvā prayatnena dadau tasmai svakāṃ tanum ||53|| māndhātā ca tato gatvā svarājyaṃ dvijasattamāḥ ākāśāt puṣpavṛṣṭiśca papāta dharaṇītale ||54|| māndhātā ca tato gatvā svarājyaṃ dvijasattamāḥ prajāśca pālayāmāsa dharmeṇa vinayena ca ||55|| vaśiṣṭho'pi mahātejāḥ śiṣyaiḥ parivṛtastataḥ sarvapuṇyamayaṃ ramyaṃ jagāma svāśramaṃ hi tam ||56|| evaṃ tasmin purā vṛttaṃ tīrthe kalpāmbusaṃjñake śrutaṃ mayā dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ sarvaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam ||57|| alpaṃ puṇyaṃ bahutaraṃ bhāvi kalpāmbuke dvijāḥ śṛgālatvaṃ parityajya evaṃ rājā vimuktavān ||58|| yaḥ paṭhedidamākhyānaṃ puṇyaṃ pāpāharaṃ mahat śṛṇuyādapi yatnena sa puṇyāṃ labhate gatim ||59|| idaṃ śrutvā janāḥ sarve namantu bhujagaṃ sadā māndhātā bhujagaṃ hatvā hyavāpa gatimīdṛśīm ||60|| iti śrīkapilapurāṇe śṛgālavimukto nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ ||7||
athāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ alpāmbutīrthamāhātmyaṃ śrutamasmābhirādarāt tatra guhyāni tīrthāni śrotukāmā vayaṃ mune ||1|| bharadvāja uvāca tatra mṛtyuñjayaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ devagaṇaiḥ stutam mṛkaṇḍutanayo yatra snātvā mṛtyurjigīyate ||2|| mṛtyuñjaye tīrthavare yo naraḥ snānamācaret mṛtyuñjayaṃ samālokya so'pi mṛtyuṃ jighāṃsati ||3|| kroḍatīrthaṃ ca tatrāste paramaṃ pāvanaṃ mahat kroḍarūpī jagannāthaḥ sākṣāttīrthatvamāgataḥ ||4|| tatra snānaṃ vidhāyāśu kroḍadehe ca līyate iti mantraṃ samuccāryya smarenmṛtyuñjayaṃ prabhum ||5|| tīrtharāja namastubhyaṃ kāruṇyaka jalāpluta aghaughāduddhara tvaṃ māṃ majjantaṃ pāhi māṃ prabho ||6|| tatraiva śukatīrthaṃ ca vāsudevapadapradam tatra snātvā sakṛlloko dīvyalokātparaṃ vrajet ||7|| tīrthaṃ siddheśvaraṃ nāma siddhidaṃ sarvakāmadam evaṃ stutvā payaḥpitvā siddhāḥ siddhitvamāyayuḥ ||8|| siddheśvare sakṛdeva mastake pātite dvijāḥ tasya tuṣṭaḥ prajānāthaḥ siddhiṃ dadyādyathepsitām ||9|| siddheśvare manojñe ca prasannasalile śubhe snātaṃ yena dinaikaṃ ca snātaṃ tena jagattraye ||10|| evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ tasya puṇyaṃ siddheśvarasya ca siddheśvare naraḥ snātvā siddhiṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam ||11|| nānāvidhāni tīrthāni tatra santi dvijottamāḥ nānāvidhāstathā devā nānāsiddhagaṇāstathā ||12|| yo vrajedvirajaḥkṣetre madhumāse narottamaḥ āśvine mādhave vāpi tasya siddhirbhaveddhruvam ||13|| dolasya sthānaṃ kroḍaṃ ca tatra paśyanti ye narāḥ brahmahatyādipāpāni kṣayitvā muktimāyayuḥ ||14|| bhaumavāre caturdaśyāṃ vāre vātha vṛhaspateḥ yaḥ paśyedvirajaṃ bhaktyā manuṣyo bhaktimāpnuyāt ||15|| tatra śrīvirajāgre ca yaḥ paṭhen mantramuttamam sa mantraḥ siddhidaḥ tasya satyaṃ satyaṃ dvijottamāḥ ||16|| tatpṛṣṭhabhāge yo nityaṃ pūjayet sindhujāpatim sthaṇḍile pratimāyāṃ va śālagrāme'thavā śubhe ||17|| gandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca naivedyairdhūpairdīpaiḥ stavairstathā mālābhirvā'pi tāmbūlaiḥ pūjayecca janārdanam ||18|| ṣaṇmāsābhyantare devo dadāti varamīpsitam prāpya siddhiṃ mṛte caiva gacchedviṣṇumanāmayam ||11|| evaṃ cāsya guṇāḥ santi virajākhyasya nirmalāḥ vaktuṃ śaknoti ko dehī vinā śeṣeṇa sattamāḥ ||20|| sahasrayojanānte ca yo japedvirajāṃ śubhaḥ tasyepsitamasau devī dadāti kila tatparā ||21|| virajākhyaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhā evaṃ nigaditaṃ mayā tatra yūyaṃ tapastaptvā parāṃ siddhiṃ gamiṣyatha ||22|| iti śrīkapilapurāṇe girijāmāhātmyaṃ nāma aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ ||8||
atha navamo'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ purā tvayā nigaditāḥ kṛṣṇārkapārvatīharāḥ adhunā śrotukāmāśca vayaṃ śambhorvadasva naḥ ||1|| tatkīrtitaṃ tvayā vipra muktidaṃ puruṣottamam maitreyaṃ virajākhyaṃ ca sarvapāpanisūdanam ||2|| nīlādri stu jalākīrṇo virajākhyastato'dhikaḥ maitreyaṃ bālukākīrṇaṃ duḥsahaṃ ravitejasā ||3|| tasmātpavitraṃ paramaṃ kiñcinnāsti tapodhanāḥ asmākaṃ tapase kṣetraṃ tasminnadrau vada prabho ||4|| tatra viśveśvaraścāste iti proktaṃ tvayā purā tasya sthānaṃ vadāsmākaṃ tadeva tapasaḥ phalam ||5|| bharadvāja uvāca vakṣyāmi paramaṃ puṇyaṃ sthānaṃ śambhordvijottamāḥ sarvapāpaharaṃ ramyaṃ kailāśaṃ parvatottamam ||6|| virajaikāmrayormadhye kailāśaṃ ca śrutaṃ dvijāḥ sarvapāpaharo devastatra śrīśikhareśvaraḥ ||7|| vakulaiścampakairvṛkṣaiḥ sapuṣpairupaśobhitam sapallavaiścūtapūgairnārikelaiḥ savāmaraiḥ ||8|| kharjūrairarjunaiścaiva panasaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ karkandhūkulakairvṛkṣardāḍimaiḥ priyadarśanaiḥ ||9|| vilvairlodhraiḥ palāśaiśca punnāgaistuṅgakeśaraiḥ jambudantaśaṭairvṛkṣaiḥ kovidāraiḥ phalārditaiḥ ||10|| tintiḍīvaṭavṛkṣaiśca khadiraiścampakaistathā pāribhadrai śca vakulairdhātrībhirnāgakeśaraiḥ ||11|| jātikājūthikābhiśca puṣpaiścaiva suvāsitaiḥ tagarairmallikābhiśca karavīraiḥ sapāṭalaiḥ ||12|| aśokairmālatībhiśca mādhavībhiḥ kadambakaiḥ sevantikābhiḥ kundaiśca kāñcanaiḥ śvetaraktakaiḥ ||13|| evaṃ nānāvidhairvṛkṣaiḥ puṣpairnānāvidhairnaraiḥ viśvanāthasya tatsthānaṃ pūritaṃ vai samantataḥ ||14|| śikhareśaṃ samāsādya samvatsaramatandri taḥ mantreṇāśrayate yastu tasya mantraḥ prasidhyati ||15|| tatrāsau viśvanāthastu viśvasyotpādane rataḥ mokṣadaḥ kāmadaḥ śrīmān liṅgarūpī na saṃśayaḥ ||16|| puṇyakṣetrāṇi santyajya puṇyasthānānyanekaśaḥ kailāśe pārvatīnāthaḥ ekākī ca parantapaḥ ||17|| yadoddhṛtaśca kailāśo rāvaṇena durātmanā tadekaśṛṅgaṃ patitaṃ tatkailāśamihocyate ||18|| kailāśādadhikaṃ manye karmabhūmau yataḥ sthitam tatra karmaphalaṃ bhogastatra bhogāśca kevalam ||19|| kailāśe śaṅkarasthāne ye vasanti narottamāḥ iha bhogaphalāvāptirmuktisteṣāṃ kare sthitā ||20|| kailāśanilayaṃ śambhordurlabhaṃ muktidāyakam yatra devagaṇāḥ santi nityaṃ śambhoḥ samīpataḥ ||21|| ālokya śikhareśaṃ ca pūjayitvā praṇamya ca surabhīmāraṇaṃ doṣaṃ kṣiptvā'rdhyaṃ ca vrajennaraḥ ||22|| gurupatnīkṛtaṃ doṣaṃ gurunindāṃ kṛtāṃ tathā vrajetkṣipraṃ kṣayahetuṃ smaranvai śikhareśvaram ||23|| brahmādidevatāḥ sarvāḥ kāṅkṣanti ca muhurmuhuḥ bhūmilokaṃ kadā gatvā dra kṣyāmaḥ śikhareśvaram ||24|| kāṅkṣanti pitaraścaiva prajāśca sunṛpaṃ yathā yadāsmākaṃ kule jātaḥ kailāśādriṃ gamiṣyati ||25|| tatra gatvā prayatnena snāti tīrthe payo'mṛte asmākaṃ tarpayitvā ca narakāduddhariṣyati ||26|| tasminnadrau dvijaśreṣṭhāstīrthamasti payo'mṛtam agre śrīśikhareśasya īśānadiśamāsthitam ||27|| vareṇyaṃ paramaṃ puṇyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ muktidāyakam yatra snātvā ca saudāso rājā muktimavāpa ha ||28|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ tattīrthasya ca māhātmyaṃ vistareṇa dadasva naḥ anyatīrthasya māhātmyaṃ tasminnadrau dvijotamāḥ ||29|| bhāradvāja uvāca bhogavatyāṃ ca bhūrloke svarloke sacarācare payo'mṛtasamaṃ tīrthaṃ nāsti nāsti vadāmyaham ||30|| purā satye ca saudāso ravivaṃśe mahīpatiḥ babhūva naraśārdūlaḥ prajāpālanatatparaḥ ||31|| vaktā śrotā mahāśānto vṛhaspatirivāparaḥ rūpeṇa ratināthastu saṃgrāme śacināyakaḥ ||32|| tasya buddhiḥ samutpannā mantraṃ sādhayituṃ purā vaśiṣṭaṃ paripapraccha nṛpatiḥ svapuraḥ sthitam ||33|| saudāsa uvāca mantrasiddhirbhavetkutra tatsthānaṃ vada sattama yatra snātvā ca japtvā ca gamiṣyāmi paraṃ padam ||34|| āste vārāṇasī kṣetraṃ muktidaṃ siddhikāmadam yatra viśveśvaro devaḥ sādhakānāṃ varapradaḥ ||35|| vārāṇasīsamaṃ bhūpa kṣetraṃ nāsti mahītale liṅgarūpadharaḥ sākṣād yatra devo jagatpatiḥ ||36|| tasmin kṣetre mahīpāla tīrthaṃ śrīmaṇikarṇikā snātvā tatra naro nārī brahmahatyātpramucyate ||37|| yatra bhāgīrathī puṇyā narāṇāṃ muktidāyinī bhūloke caiva pātāle svargaloke pratiṣṭhitā ||38|| bhāgīrathyāśca māhātmyaṃ vistaraṃ gaditaṃ purā yadambu kaṇamātraṃ ca brahmahatyāṃ kṣayaṃ nayet ||39|| vārāṇasī viśvanātho jāhnavī maṇikarṇikā ekaikā durlabhā rājan kimu yatra catuṣṭayam ||40|| bharadvāja uvāca iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā maharṣeśca narādhipaḥ tamṛṣiṃ praṇipatyāśu pratasthe kṣetramuttamam ||41|| gatvā snātvā ca gaṅgayāṃ dṛṣṭvā ca pārvatīpatim kṣamāsatyasamāyuktastapastepe sudāruṇam ||42|| evaṃ ca katicit kāle gate devo maheśvaraḥ svarūpaṃ darśayitvā taṃ svapne vākyamuvāca ha ||43|| śaṅkara uvāca āgataste mahābāho kṣetraṃ muktipradaṃ mama idānīṃ gaccha tapase kailāśanilayaṃ mama ||44|| tatrāhaṃ darśayiṣyāmi satyaṃ tvāṃ māmakīṃ tanum muktiṃ caiva pradāsyāmi satyaṃ satyaṃ mayoditam ||45|| matpārśve caiva hātendra tīrthaṃ nāma payo'mṛtam caturvargapradaścaiva tatrāhaṃ śikhareśvaraḥ ||46|| sarvapāpaharaṃ liṅgaṃ nāmnā śrīśikhareśvaram yo māṃ paśyati tatrasthaṃ tasmairmuktiṃ dadāmyaham ||47|| tatra tattapasā tuṣṭo yuge satye mahīpate tretāyāṃ dvāpare caiva darśanāt siddhidaḥ svayam ||48|| kalau ca darśanenaiva siddhido'haṃ nṛṇāṃ kila tasminnadrau tīrthavare yaḥ snāti ca payo'mṛte ||49|| sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ maddehe ca pralīyate payo'mṛte mahātīrthe payastenāmṛtopamam ||50|| amṛtatvaṃ prayacchāśu kṛte snāne tavāmbhasi anena vidhinā bhūpa tatra snānaṃ samācara ||51|| tatra snātvā ca māṃ dṛṣṭvā parāṃ siddhiṃ gamiṣyasi tatraiva tīrthaṃ pravaraṃ madagre pāpanāśanam ||52|| jaṃbhakunumiti khyātaṃ kiṃcadagre yamasthitam patanti tatra vārīṇi sarvāṅgaśubhadāni ca sarvalokapavitrāṇi sarvalokaśubhāni ca ||53|| parvatodbhavaśītāni tatra snātvā sukhaṃ labhet jaleṣu ca śiro datvā śuddho bhūtvā narottamaḥ ||54|| tatra snānena yatpuṇyaṃ śṛṇuṣva ravivaṃśaja kailāśakuṇḍe susnātaḥ pūjayitvā maheśvaram ||55|| naraḥ sidhimavāpnoti tatprasādānna saṃśayaḥ tattoye mama tīrthe ca pūjanīyaḥ sthito hyaham ||56|| tatra gatvā mantrajapāllabhate muktirūpatām ityuktvā gatavān devo rājā nidro tthitastadā ||57|| ekākī ca gataḥ śrīmān kailāśācalamuttamam tatra rājā tapastaptvā snātvā tīrthe payo'mṛte ||58|| kañcitkālaṃ sthitaścāsau paścān muktiṃ jagāma ha ekākī devadeveśastatra kailāśaparvate ||59|| tatra kolāhalaṃ kṛtvā narake pacyate dhravam evaṃ mayā nigaditaṃ tatsthānaṃ parvatottamam tatra gatvā tapastaptvā parāṃ siddhiṃ gamiṣyathaḥ ||60|| iti atha daśamo'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ tatra kolāhalaṃ kṛtvā naro narakamāviśet vayaṃ tatra gamiṣyāmo bharadvāja kathaṃ vada ||1|| samyak sthānaṃ tvayā proktaṃ kailāśaṃ pārvatīpateḥ tapastaptuṃ mahat sthānaṃ kevalaṃ doṣavarjitam ||2|| utkale kṣetramaparaṃ kiñcidasti tapodhana tadvadāśu dvijaśreṣṭha asmākaṃ ca hitecchayā ||3|| tvatprasādādbhaviṣyāmaḥ kṛtārthā munisattama guhyaṃ kimaparaṃ hyasti kṣipraṃ vada mahāmate ||4|| bharadvāja uvāca ekāgramanaso bhūtvā śṛṇudhvaṃ munisattamāḥ ākhyātaṃ kasyacitpūrvaṃ gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ ||5|| guhyādguhyatamaṃ jñeyaṃ parātparataraṃ smṛtam ekāgrakaraṇaṃ nāma tasminnadrau tapodhanāḥ ||6|| prāṇināṃ muktidaṃ śastaṃ devānāṃ jayavarddhanam nirmalaṃ ca nirākāraṃ kṣetraṃ hariharātmakam ||7|| narasiddhagaṇākīrṇaṃ munīndrai rupaśobhitam gandharvaiḥ kinnarairjuṣṭaṃ vidyādharasacāraṇaiḥ ||8|| āmranimbakadambaiśca sapuṣpaiśca phalānvitaiḥ pūgaiḥ panasakairvṛkṣairnyagrodhairvakulaistathā ||9|| palāśairmucukundaiśca pārijātaiḥ priyāṅgubhiḥ karkandhunaganāraṅgairvṛkṣairrājādanairapi ||10|| khadiraiścaiva vilvaiśca vañcubhiḥ karahāṭakaiḥ karṇikārairjapāpuṣpaiḥ kapitthaiḥ cipumandakaiḥ ||11|| campakairatimuktaiśca supuṣpairnāgakeśaraiḥ śālatālaśirīṣaiśca jambīraiḥ priyadarśanaiḥ ||12|| kadalīvanaṣaṇḍaiśca pūritaṃ sumanoharaiḥ karvīraiḥ kaṇikāraiśca kapitthairbahulairvaraiḥ ||13|| yūthikāmallikābhiśca jātīlakucakaistathā aśokairvakulaiścaiva dvirephagaṇaśobhitaiḥ ||14|| mālatīlatikābhiśca dāḍimairvījapūrakaiḥ evaṃ nānāvidhairvṛkṣaiḥ tadvanaṃ pūritaṃ dvijāḥ ||15|| daśādanaiḥ khañjaviṭaiḥ kokilaiḥ kalaniḥsvanaiḥ caṭakaiścātakaiścaiva cakoraiścitrapakṣibhiḥ ||16|| vyāghrāṭaiḥ kukkuṭaiścaiva śiromukuṭabhūṣitaiḥ pārāvataiḥ sūkṣmapakṣaiḥ lohapṛṣṭhairvarānane ||17|| kādambai rājahaṃsaiśca priyāyuktaiḥ śukaistathā vartikaistittirībhiśca mayūrairghananṛtyakaiḥ ||18|| siṃhairvyāghraiśca khaṅgaiśca bhūdāraiklañcagairmṛgaiḥ evaṃ nānā vidhairanyaiścatuṣpādairvihaṅgamaiḥ ||19|| pūritaṃ tadvanaṃ puṇyaṃ svajātipariniṣṭhitaiḥ dīrghikābhistaḍāgaiśca padmotpalavirājitaiḥ ||20|| kāraṇḍavaiḥ plavairhaṃsaistavakairjalakukkuṭaiḥ akardamaiḥ svacchatoyaiḥ sopānena virājitaiḥ ||21|| evaṃ nānāvidhaguṇaiḥ samantāt paripūritam ekāgraṃ paramaṃ puṇyaṃ vanaṃ viṣṇupriyaṃ mahat ||22|| suvāsitairgandhavatyā urmibhirgurucañcalaiḥ vāmavikṣepitaiḥ puṇyaiḥ śītalaṃ sumanoharam ||23|| sākṣādvaikuṇṭhabhuvanaṃ jānīdhvaṃ munisattamāḥ ekāgre tu jagannātho bhāti pāṣāṇanīlayā ||24|| śaṅkhacakradharaḥ śrīmān vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ yatra viśveśvaraḥ śambhuḥ sākṣānnārāyaṇātmakaḥ ||25|| yasmādyūyaṃ muktikāmāstasmādvai tatra gacchata ||26|| iti śrīkapilapurāṇe ekāmravarṇanaṃ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ ||10||
athaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ vistareṇa samākhyāhi kṣetramekāmrakaṃ mune āśramāṇi ca ramyāṇi tatra liṅgāni koṭiśaḥ ||1|| śrotukāmā vayaṃ sarve gamiṣyāmo na saṃśayaḥ pūjayāmo virūpākṣaṃ nīradābhaṃ janārdanam ||2|| bharadvāja uvāca kṣetramekāmrakaṃ śrīmat paramānandadāyakam samantātkrośamātraṃ ca koṭiliṅgāvṛtā mahī ||3|| tatrāsau devadevastu svagaṇaiḥ pārvatīpatiḥ varado muktido nṝṇāṃ sādhakānāṃ ca siddhidaḥ ||4|| paramānandarūpeṇa saṃsthitaḥ parameśvaraḥ parātparataro jñeyo brahmādīnāṃ varapradaḥ ||5|| vārāṇasīṃ parityajya jalākīrṇo maheśvaraḥ prārthayitvā hareḥ puṇyamekāmre vanamāviśet ||6|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ prārthitaṃ ca kadā'nena śambhunā liṅgarūpiṇā sarvametattu vṛtāntaṃ vistareṇa vada prabho ||7|| bharadvāja uvāca purā tretāyuge viprā vārāṇasyāṃ maheśvaraḥ tiṣṭhan vākyamuvācedaṃ nāradaṃ munipuṅgavam ||8|| śiva uvāca asyāṃ pūryāmadhiṣṭhāya narasyāgho vinaśyati jāteyaṃ ca janākīrṇā tapovighnakarī mune ||9|| yatsthānaṃ ca janākīrṇaṃ tatra sthātuṃ na yujyate upadra vo bhavettatra nāstikairjñānadurvalaiḥ ||10|| nāstikā yatra tiṣṭhanti tatra dharmo na vidyate adharmācca bhavellupto harerbhāgo munīśvarāḥ ||11|| etatsthānaṃ prayatnena pārvatyarthaṃ purā kṛtam pārvatyā ruciraṃ yatra tatsthānaṃ mama harṣadam ||12|| adhunātra muniśreṣṭha sthātuṃ notsahate manaḥ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ sthānaṃ kutrāsti māṃ vadāśu ca ||13|| nārada uvāca lavaṇasyodadhestīre līlaśailo nagottamaḥ taduttarasyāṃ vikhyātaṃ kṣetramekāmrakaṃ prabho ||14|| tatra śrīvāsudevastu ramānātho jagadguruḥ anantena saha śrīmān ekākī vijane vane ||15|| tatsthānaṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ na jānāti prajāpatiḥ bhagavānapi jānāti devatānāṃ ca kā kathā ||16|| ekāmraṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ jagannāthasya cakriṇaḥ kroḍasthitā'bdhikanyāpi naiva jānāti śaṅkaraḥ ||17|| sākṣādvigrahavāntatra anantena janārdanaḥ sṛṣṭyutpattināśau ca sthitistena vicāryate ||18|| sarvadā sopyanantastu devena saha tiṣṭhati lakṣmaṇo rāmacandra śca kṛṣṇo vai rohiṇīsutaḥ ||19|| divasānekaparyyantaṃ tapastatvā maheśvaraḥ prasanno vāsudevaśca jñātaṃ taiḥ kṣetramuttamam ||20|| ahaṃ śeṣo jagannāthastrayāṇāṃ tatra saṅgatiḥ indrā dīnāṃ ca devanāmanyeṣāṃ ca na vidyate ||21|| evaṃ paramapuṇyaṃ tan mayā jñātaṃ purā prabho idānīṃ bhavatā jñātaṃ kṣetraṃ paramapāvanam ||22|| bharadvāja uvāca evaṃ nigadite tasminnārade caṇḍikāpatiḥ munipāṇau karaṃ dattvā gantuṃ cakre manastadā ||23|| gaṇādhyakṣamuvācedaṃ vacanaṃ nandikeśvaram ekāmrakaṃ gamiṣyāmi sajjī bhaktu putraka ||24|| gṛhītvā tarasā gaccha vṛṣendraṃ girijāṃ śubhām nāthājñāṃ śirasā dhṛtvā śūlapāṇiryayau tadā ||25|| samānīya ca vṛṣabhaṃ pārvatī nirjagāma ha koṭiliṅgādyathāsaṃkhyaṃ kathayāmāsa satvaram ||26|| sajjībhavadhvaṃ yūyaṃ ca gataikāmraṃ jagadguruḥ ityuktvā gatavāṃstatra gṛhītvā girijāṃ vṛṣam ||27|| svayaṃ veśadharo bhūtvā devadevaḥ samāruhat koṭicandra pratīkāśaṃ nānābhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ||28|| dṛṣṭvā svavāhanaṃ śambhurnandinaṃ prasaśaṃsa ha tato'sau nandikeśastu devadevasya karṇayoḥ ||29|| kuṇḍalaṃ sajjayāmāsa nānāratnavirājitam koṭisūryyapratīkāśaṃ hemavaidūryyanirmalam ||30|| mūrdhni deśe sumukuṭamarddhacandra vibhūṣitam karpūramiśritaṃ śuddhaṃ candanaṃ ca suvāsitam ||31|| śītalaṃ pārvatīśasya bhālapaṭṭe ca lepitam tato gaṇḍasthale caiva kuṅkumaṃ mṛgapatrikām ||32|| tāmbūlamadhare śuddhaṃ dadau nandī sasatvaraḥ hṛdaye cojjvalaṃ hāraṃ māṇikyaṃ mauktikaṃ tathā ||33|| galena rañjayāmāsa candanaṃ puṣpamālikām padmarāgayutau hemau kaṅkaṇau suprakāśitau ||34|| dadau śrīkarayostaptau vidyudābhāśca candri kāḥ tatra paṭṭāmbaraṃ kaṭyāṃ nīvīvastraṃ tatopari ||35|| mekhalāṃ svañjayāmāsa kṣudra ghaṇṭāṃ suśobhitām pādayornūpuraṃ divyaṃ nīlendra maṇisaṃyutam ||36|| suveśamevaṃ devasya nandikeśaścakāra ha suveśaḥ sumukhaḥ śrīmān koṭicandra dyutirharaḥ ||37|| lasati savṛṣo devo kroḍe kṛtvā himādri jām itthaṃ bhūtvā jagāmāśu gīyamānaḥ puraḥsaraiḥ ||38|| cāmarairvyajanaiḥ śubhraiḥ siddhagandharvakinnaraiḥ śvetātapatraṃ śirasi koṭyarkadyutinindakam ||39|| dīrghanādaṃ suvistīrṇaṃ ramyaṃ bhṛkuṭinartanam jayaśabdaṃ tathā nṛtyaṃ kurvantyapsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ ||40|| triśūlaṃ ḍamarūṃ caiva vyāghrāmbarasamanvitaḥ evaṃ śrīpārvatīnātho bhaktānāṃ varadāyakaḥ ||41|| ekāmraṃ prāpayāmāsa nāradena mahātmanā gatvaikāmre damenāsau vāsudevaṃ sanātanam sāṣṭāṅgena praṇamyāśu stutimetāṃ cakāra ha ||42|| śrīśaṅkara uvāca namaste paramānanda namo nīlābhalocana namaste haraye tubhyaṃ trayīmūrtidharāya ca ||43|| nīlajībhūtavapuṣe namaste lokanāyaka devānāṃ varadātā'si prasannātihara prabho ||44|| ekāmrakanivāsāya namaste pītavāsase triguṇairvāhyarūpāya śaṅkhacakrāvadhāriṇe ||45|| tvameka jagatāmādiḥ kāraṇānāṃ ca kāraṇam bhaktabandho jagannātha karuṇāmayasāgara ||46|| tava sthānāni ramyāṇi santi deva sahasraśaḥ ekāmre guptarūpaṃ ca na jānāmi kathaṃ prabho ||47|| māmuvāca purā viṣṇo tvaṃ mamārddhaśarīrakaḥ idānīṃ tu kathaṃ rājyaṃ kṛtavānasi keśava ||48|| nāradastava bhaktastu śayyā te bhujageśvaraḥ kevalaṃ tau hi jānītaḥ kṛpā nāsti mayi prabho ||49|| gopīnāṃ premabhaktānāṃ dattā bhaktistvayā prabho sanakādyāśca tiṣṭhanti īśvarecchā niraṅkuśāḥ ||50|| ekāmravipine ramye tiṣṭhanti parameśvara yoganidrāṃ samāśritya locanārddhau ca mudri tau ||51|| idānīṃ karuṇāṃ kṛtvā dehi me jagadīśvara svasthānaṃ dehi me sthātumāgato'haṃ tavāntike ||52|| stutiritthaṃ prakurvāṇe himādri tanayāpatau unmīlya locane viṣṇurvihasan vākyamabravīt ||53|| śrīvāsudeva uvāca śṛṇu madvacanaṃ śambho kathayāmi hitaṃ tava sthātuṃ sthānaṃ pradāsyāmi kuru satyaṃ mamāgrataḥ ||54|| naiva kāśīnivāsāya sthāsyāmyatra ca sarvadā svagaṇairāvṛto nityamiti satyaṃ maheśvara ||55|| śrīśaṅkara uvāca kāśīṃ kathaṃ na yāsyāmi tatrāste jāhnāvī mama sarvatīrthamayī puṇyā tīrthaṃ me maṇikarṇikā ||56|| vāsudeva uvāca nāradastu na jānāti naiva śeṣo girīśvara ahameva vijānāmi viddhi tvamadhunā hara ||57|| atraiva jāhnavītyasti matpādāgracyutā śubhā āgneyyāṃ diśi pṛṣṭhe me gaṅgā ca munisaṃjñakā ||58|| anyatrānyatra tīrthāni suguptāni ca santi me paścātsarvāṇi vakṣyāmi kuru satyaṃ ca śaṅkara ||59|| śaṅkara uvāca satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmyatra tiṣṭhāmi madhusūdana vārāṇasīṃ parityajya anyakṣetrāṇi mādhava ||60|| ekāmravipine sthāsye tava sannihite prabho satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ na yāsyāmi ca kutracit ||61|| ityuktvā bhagavān śambhustadviṣṇordakṣiṇe diśi digrūpadharaścāste caturvargaphalapradaḥ ||62|| mūle sphaṭikasaṅkāśaṃ mahānīlaṃ ca madhyamam māṇikyādisamamagryaṃ liṅgaṃ tribhuvaneśvaram ||63|| bhāradvāja uvāca tataḥ prabhṛti bho viprāḥ kṣetre rājā maheśvaraḥ koṭiliṅgāvṛtaḥ śrīmān vāsudevastu pālakaḥ ||64|| tasya paśyanti ye liṅgamekāmre munisattamāḥ brahma hatyāyutā vāpi muktisteṣāṃ kare sthitā ||65|| evaṃ śambhuḥ prārthayitvā vāsudevaṃ sanātanam ekāmravipine hyāste koṭiliṅgadharaḥ prabhuḥ ||66|| iti śrīkapilapurāṇe ekāmre maheśāgamanaṃ nāma ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||11||
atha dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣayaḥ ūcuḥ tasmin tīrthe dvijaśreṣṭha vada tīrthaṃ phalapradam nāmadheyaṃ tathotpannaṃ suguptaṃ cakrapāṇinā ||1|| bharadvāja uvāca gate ca katicit kāle tatra devo maheśvaraḥ ramamāṇaḥ sthitastatra dṛśyamekamajāyata ||2|| tasmin kṣaṇe ca bho viprāḥ śravanti jalavindavaḥ tasmādvindusaro nāma cakre devagaṇaiḥ saha ||3|| puṣkarādīni tīrthāni kṣīrodādīṃśca sāgarān gaṅgādyāḥ saritaścaiva sarvān devān samarcayet ||4|| sarve tatra sravantisma jalavindūnaharniśam tasmādvede purāṇe ca nāmnā vindusarovaraḥ ||5|| gaṅgā godāvarī revā tuṅgabhadrā ca narmadā kālindī sarayūścaiva tāpī tatra sravanti ca ||6|| mānasaṃ puṣkaraṃ pampā sutīkṣṇaṃ śailanirmalam sravantyetāni sarvāṇi tīrthe vindūdbhave dvijāḥ ||7|| kṣīrodhirlavaṇodhiśca payodhirdugdha eva ca santi vindūdbhave tīrthe dadhisarpiḥsurārṇavāḥ ||8|| dvārāvatyāṃ ca tattīrthaṃ naimiṣe daṇḍake vane tāni vindūdbhave nityaṃ tathā vadarikāśrame ||9|| ekāmrakavane viprāstīrthaṃ bindusaraḥ śrutam tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca na naro narakaṃ vrajet ||10|| tīrthaṃ vindūdbhavaṃ viprā munīndrai rupasevitam pavitraṃ nirmalajalaṃ sopānairupaśobhitam ||11|| svarge martye ca pātāle hyantarikṣe tathā diśi na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyaṃ ca tīrthaṃ vindūdbhavātparam ||12|| vindūdbhavaṃ jalaṃ viprā amṛtaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ vindūdbhave naraḥ snātvā yaḥ paśyedvṛṣabhadhvajam ||13|| sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śivadehe pralīyate atra caiva dvijaśreṣṭhā devī pādaharā śrutā ||14|| tāṃ dṛṣṭvā pūjayitvā ca narastu sukhamedhate pāde devyā haro yasmāt tasmātpādaharā smṛtā ||15|| tatra snātvā ca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā paścātpaśyenmaheśvaram yā'sau pādaharā devī narāṇāṃ sukhadāyinī ||16|| dvitīye vigrahe śreyaḥ dātrī sarvasya vidyate snātvā vindūdbhave tīrthe dṛṣṭvā pādaharāṃ śubhām ||17|| tasmāttīrtheśvaraṃ pūjya naro mucyeta pātakāt vindutīrthe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā śrīpuruṣottamam ||18|| devīṃ pādaharāṃ dṛṣṭvā hyakṣayaṃ ca phalaṃ labhet yastu paśyati talliṅgaṃ nāmnā tribhuvaneśvaram ||19|| devadevo jagatsvāmī tasmai muktiṃ prayacchati tasmintīrthavare snātvā dṛṣṭvā śrīdharaśaṅkaram ||20|| kāmagena vimānena vaiṣṇavaṃ padamāpnuyāt śreṣṭhaṃ ca sarvatīrthānāṃ vindūdbhavamudāhṛtam ||21|| etannigaditaṃ viprāḥ tīrthaṃ vindūdbhavaṃ śubham aparaṃ kathayiṣyāmi kiṃ viprā vadata śubham ||22|| puṇyākhyānamidaṃ yena paṭhyate śrūyate'thavā sarvapāpakṣayaṃ kṛtvā so'mṛtatvamavāpnuyāt ||23|| iti śrīkapilapurāṇe vindūdbhavo nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||12||
atha trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ vistareṇa samākhyāhi kṣetramāhātmyamuttamam vāsudevasya māhātmyaṃ koṭiliṅgeśvarasya tu ||1|| bharadvāja uvāca ekāmrakaṃ vanaṃ śrīmatkṣetrāṇāmuttamaṃ varam ekāmrasadṛśaṃ kṣetraṃ bhūmau nāsti dvijottamāḥ ||2|| tadeva paramaṃ sthānaṃ tadeva paramaṃ padam nirbhayā nivasantyatra sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ ||3|| sarvatīrthamayaṃ hyetadekāmravanasaṃjñitam tīrthe sākṣātparaṃ brahma liṅgarūpī vasatyasau ||4|| ekāmrakaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvakṣetrādhikaṃ phalam kāmadaṃ mokṣadaṃ caiva sarvapuṇyavivardhanam ||5|| ye narāstatra gacchanti kṛtasaṃkalpamānasāḥ pāpaṃ nirdahantyāśu uddhareyuḥ kulāni vai ||6|| ekāmrasadṛśaṃ kṣetraṃ naiva paśyāmi kiṃcana pāpino yatra gatvā ca labheyurmokṣamuttamam ||7|| śarīraṃ vipine tasmin ye tyajanti narottamāḥ te yānti śivasānnidhyaṃ bhāsamānāḥ priyamvadāḥ ||8|| hatyākoṭiyuto vāpi goghno vā gurutalpagaḥ ekāmravigrahaṃ dṛṣṭvā yānti viṣṇusanātanam ||9|| hariśaṅkarayormadhye jale vindūdbhave dvijāḥ koṭako'pi tyajandehaṃ nūnaṃ yāti paraṃ padam ||10|| agre śrīvāsudevasva śarīraṃ tyajati tu yaḥ jalamadhyai dvijaśreṣṭhā vāsudeve ca līyate ||11|| tatra tyaktvā śarīraṃ svaṃ kīṭādyā jaṅgamāstathā sarve muktipathaṃ yānti manuṣyāṇāṃ ca kiṃ punaḥ ||12|| ekāmrake yadā jantustyajati svaśarīrakam dātā śrībhagavān śaṃbhuḥ karṇamūle paṭhedidam ||13|| tvamatra tyajasi dehaṃ purā puṇyaṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā badoṅkāraṃ vraja paraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca sanātanam ||14|| iti mantraṃ samucāryya karṇamūle maheśvaraḥ svagaṇānpreṣayitvā ca nirākaraṃ nayeddhruvam ||15|| dakṣiṇe gajarājasya vṛkṣaścāmalako dvijāḥ sarvapāpaharaścāsau svayaṃ devena nirmitaḥ ||16|| karoti nūnaṃ nityaṃ hi vāsudevapriyaṃ śubham viśeṣo'yaṃ tarurviprāḥ kṣetrarājasthito yataḥ ||17|| tanmūle ye tyajantisma śarīraṃ pāpakṛttamāḥ te muktiṃ ca gatā viprāḥ kiṃ punaḥ puṇyakarmaṇām ||18|| aviśvāsakṛtānāṃ ca etāṃ na parameśvaraḥ imamālakaṃ vṛkṣaṃ viśvāsārthaṃ cakāra ha ||19|| tatraikāmragṛhe vāhye antarikṣe jale sthale yatra tatra śarīraṃ ca tyaktvā muktimavāpnuyāt ||20|| durvṛttaḥ sādhurvṛtto vā yasya vāso dvijottamāḥ tyaktvaikāmraṃ tvadehaṃ ca naro vaikuṇṭhamālabhet ||21|| evaṃ nānāvidhaguṇāḥ tasyaikāmravanasya ca yatra sākṣājjagatsvāmī darśanānmuktido mataḥ ||22|| vighneśvaraṃ vṛṣaṃ devaṃ devīṃ ca śrīguhaṃ tarum sāvitrīṃ yaḥ samālokya na mātusstanado bhavet ||23|| koṭiliṅgeśvaraṃ tatra ye'rcayanti samāhitāḥ teṣāṃ bhāgyavatāṃ janma saphalaṃ parikīrtitam ||24|| gandhaiḥ puṣpaistathā dhūpairdīpairnaivedyakairapi mālābhistāmbulaiścaiva ekāmravipine śivam ||25|| pūjayanti naraśreṣṭhā ye saṃtaptamānasāḥ teṣāṃ gatiṃ dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ kathayāmi vaḥ ||26|| nānāvidhairvimānaiśca siddhagandharvasevitaiḥ patākābhirdhvajaiḥ śubhaiḥ apsarogaṇanṛtyakaiḥ ||27|| indra nīlapratīkāśaiḥ padmarāganibhaistathā nirmitaiḥ svarṇamuktābhyāṃ śivi śaṅkaraveṣṭitaiḥ ||28|| vrajanti śivasānnidhyaṃ te narāḥ dṛṣṭamānasāḥ yathepsitāni bhogāni tatra bhuñjanti mānavāḥ ||29|| asau devo rūpākṣo brahmarūpī na saṃśayaḥ asya darśanamātreṇa brahmahatyā vinaśyati ||30|| ekāmravipine nūnaṃ liṅgarūpinamavyayam bhaktyā paśyanti ye nityaṃ teṣāṃ muktiḥ kare sthitā ||31|| naivedyaṃ yasya devasya mahāpātakanāśanam brahmādīnāṃ ca devānāṃ bhogyaṃ brāhmaṇasattamāḥ ||32|| ekāmravipine viprāḥ liṅgaṃ sākṣātsanātanam naivedyaṃ yasya vāñchanti śakrādyāstridivaukasaḥ ||33|| agrāhyamīśanaivedyaṃ na bhoktavyamiti dvijāḥ yāni vākyāni tānyatra nādri yante kadācana ||34|| mahāprasādaṃ naivedyamiti prāhurmaharṣayaḥ ekāmrakānane viṣṇordehe brāhmaṇasattamāḥ ||35|| naivedye liṅgarājasya puṇye saṃkhyāṃ ca mā kṛthāḥ tadanādṛtya narakaṃ yānti nāsyatra saṃśayaḥ ||36|| tasya śrīliṅgarājasya dhvajāropaṇamuttamam yaḥ karoti naraḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sa śivatvaṃ ca gacchati paṭṭavastrairnīlavastraiḥ pītaśuklāmbaraistathā ||37|| ye kurvanti narāstatra dhvajāropaṇamīśvare brahmahatyādipāpāni kṣayitvā te narottamāḥ ||38|| pitṝnuddhṛtya narakātte vrajanti śivaṃ dhruvam pūjākāle ca yastatra śrāvayanti murajadhvanim ||39|| mṛdaṅgaśaṅkhanādaṃ ca paṭahaṃ bherimeva ca kāhalaṃ riṇibhaṃ śabdaṃ pratnena narottamāḥ ||40|| tai śabdairveṣṭitāste ca vrajanti śivamavyayam śrutvaivaṃ tasya śabdaṃ ca naro muktiṃ vajedvijāḥ ||41|| tasya pūjāṃ samālokya na jāne kiṃ phalaṃ bhavet koṭiliṅgeśvarasyāgre yastu bhaktyā japen manum iha loke sukhī bhogī dehānte śivamāpnuyāt ||42|| koṭiliṅgeśvaro yastu tadbrahmaiva na saṃśayaḥ yamālokya narā nityaṃ prāpnuvanti manoratham ||43|| brahmādidevatāḥ sarvā yamarcayantyaharniśam bhaktyā bindūdbhave tīrthe svapadaṃ prāpnuvanti ca ||44|| nāsti nāsti samaṃ liṅgaṃ koṭiliṅgeśvarātparam bhogavatyāṃ bhūvi svarge satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmi vaḥ ||45|| ekāmravipine viprāḥ yo'sau tribhuvaneśvaraḥ tasya darśanamātreṇa naro mokṣaṃ ca gacchati ||46|| pradakṣiṇaṃ prakurvanti koṭiliṅgeśvarasya ye padātpadādbrahmapadaṃ teṣāṃ sannihitaṃ bhavet ||47|| caṇḍeśvaraṃ samāsādya savyāsavyapradakṣiṇam laṅghanaṃ somasūtrasya kṛtvā narakamaśnute ||48|| tasyāgre vṛṣarājasya svayaṃ vigrahavāndvijāḥ taṃ dṛṣṭvā pūjayitvā ca śivaprītiṃ labhennaraḥ ||49|| devasya pṛṣṭhabhāge tu nairṛtiṃ diśamāśritām sāvitrīṃ pūjayitvā ca dṛṣṭvā vāñchitamāpnuyāt ||50|| agre vighneśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā pārśve caṇḍe himādri jām pūjayitvā prayatnena narakāṃśca jighāṃsati ||51|| devasya uttare bhāge kiñcidutaradiggatam śikhidhvajaṃ samālokya naraḥ sampadamālabhet ||52|| tasya sannihite pūrve ekāmreśvarasaṃjñakam ekāmravṛkṣastatrāsītpurā kalpe tu muktidaḥ ||53|| tatra eko gataścāmrastasmādekāmrakaṃ vanam mahocchrāyaḥ suśākhī ca sumanoharapallavaḥ ||54|| dharmārthakāmamokṣāśca patravṛkṣaphalāni ca taṃ vṛkṣaṃ gopanīyaṃ ca cakārāsuranāśanaḥ ||55|| tasya mūlaṃ śameśastu taṃ nāmnā''khyātimāgatāḥ taṃ dṛṣṭvā vidhimantreṇa dharmakāmārthamāpnuyāt ||56|| tatra śrīśailajāgre ca tiktaśāko mahāndru maḥ purā śrībhagavānśambhuḥ pādapaṃ tamaropayat ||57|| tasya vṛkṣasya mahātmyaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ pāpanāśanam purā devāsure jyeṣṭhe bhairave'tyantasaṃkaṭe ||58|| indrā dyā nirjitāḥ sarve rākṣasairbaladarpitaiḥ tadendraḥ śaṅkamānastu vākyamūce bṛhaspatim ||59|| bṛhaspatiruvāca gacchaikāmraṃ śacīnātha paśya devaṃ sanātanam tiktaśākatale tatra tapastaptvā ca jeṣyasi ||60|| śrutvetthaṃ vacanaṃ tasya duṣṭanāśaparastathā kiṃ tejaḥ paramaṃ mantraṃ bahukālaṃ jajāpa ha ||61|| tataḥ śrībhagavānbhargastapasā paritoṣitaḥ ramyaṃ suśliṣṭavacanamucitaṃ valasūdanam ||62|| śaṅkara uvāca pādapo'yamahaṃ sākṣāt śṛṇudhvaṃ pākaśāsana tasya mūle japan mantraṃ dadāmi varamīpsitam ||63|| adhunā hūyatāṃ daityāntasminnekāmrakānane jetāsi kuru saṅgrāmaṃ tasminnekāmrakānane ||64|| tataḥ tridaśanāthena svīkṛtaṃ kratunāśanam saṅgataḥ tridivaṃ sarvadevatābhiḥ samanvitaḥ ||65|| saha daityaistato yuddhaṃ cakāra valasūdanaḥ ājñayā devadevasya jaghāna varadānavān ||66|| tato'mbarāt puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ puruhūtasya mastake papāta devatāḥ sarvā yayuḥ svaṃ svaṃ puraṃ tataḥ ||67|| evaṃ śrītiktaśākastu vṛkṣaḥ paramasiddhidaḥ svamantreṇa ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā manorathamavāpnuyāt ||68|| evaṃ mayā vo gaditaṃ samāsato vṛkṣasya māhātmyamatīva nirmalam mūle'sya kṛtvā paramaṃ tapaḥ purā jaghāna daityān tridaśādhipo dvijāḥ ||69|| iti śrīkapilapurāṇe śakrayogavarddhanaṃ nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||13||
atha caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ bharadvāja uvāca atha vakṣyāmi māhātmyaṃ vāsudevasya bho dvijāḥ vāsudevasya saṃkīrtyā naromuktimavāpnuyāt ||1|| tatra ekāmrake puṇye vāsudevo jagadguruḥ vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca parityajya āste vigrahavān svayam ||2|| nānāratnaiḥ sughaṭitaiḥ kaṅkaṇairbhujaśobhitaḥ kiṅkiṇībhūṣitakaṭirnaivapallavapādakaḥ ||3|| jambunīmakadambādinidrā ghūrṇitalocanaḥ kuṇḍalābhyāṃ vicitrābhyāṃ gaṇḍasthalavirājitaḥ ||4|| bhrājamāno jaṭābhiśca bhṛkuṭairnākatejasā indra nīlamaṇiśyāmaḥ śrīvatsāṅkitavigrahaḥ ||5|| dāḍimīpuṣpasaṃkāśastvadharo'mṛtadāyakaḥ rāmakṛṣṇasvarūpeṇa sthito'sau kamalādharaḥ ||6|| sākṣādbrahma svarūpo'yaṃ paraṃ brahma udāhṛtaḥ advitīyo'kṣayo nityo vāsudevetisaṃjñakaḥ ||7|| sa eva gatidātā ca sa eva paramātmakaḥ kīṭavṛkṣapataṅgeṣu sa āste hṛdayasthitaḥ ||8|| yo vā danti tataṃ puṭaṃ vāsudevaṃ nirañjanam bhaktyā taṃ naiva paśyanti pacyante raurave ciram ||9|| sarvakṣetrāṇi ramyāṇi tīrthānyāyatanāni ca parityajya jagannātha ekāmra vanamāsthitam ||10|| ekāmra pralaye viprā na nāśamadhigacchati tasmātsarvāṇi saṃtyajya āste tatra gadādharaḥ ||11|| ekāmrakaṃ vindusarovaraṃ te parātparaṃ brahmasadātmako'sti । anīśvaraḥ śāśvata īśvarastu śyāmopasandho harirarkatejaḥ ||12|| brahmasvarūpo yamatattva vastu bhaktapriyaḥ śāntamalaḥ sudehaḥ jñātvā manomānaparīkṣakāṇāṃ saraḥ phalaṃ yadyatate yathoktam ||13|| asau murāriḥ janatāpahārī rakṣārthamekastu virājamānaḥ kaumodakī śaṅkharathāṅgadhārī pītāmbaraḥ kaustubhamādadhānaḥ ||14|| brahmasvarūpo yamakalmaṣastu bhaktapriyaḥ śāntamalaḥ sudehaḥ jñātvā manomānasa rākṣasānāṃ saraḥ phalaṃ yacchati yadyathoktam ||15|| śrīvāsudevasya ca darśanena dakṣasya śeṣasya gadāyudhasya śaṭhāḥ khalā nāstikakarmayuktā ekāmrake muktimavāpnṛyuste ||16|| yo'sau sarvagato devo murāriḥ madhusūdanaḥ sa āste bhagavān sākṣādekāmravanamadhyagaḥ ||17|| pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni ṛṣīṇāmāśramāṇi ca haristāni parityajya śilārūpadharaḥ svayam ||18|| nīlādrau ca dāruvapuḥ kadācitsaṃtyajed hariḥ ekāmra na tyajedbhāti sadā pāṣāṇanīlayā ||19|| ekāmravanamadhyāste śaṅkhacakradharo hariḥ yasya smaraṇamātreṇa pātakāni yayuḥ kṣayam ||20|| kiṃ phalaṃ tanna jānāmi tasya devasya darśane puruṣottamaṃ mevātha bhajan saṃpūjayan naraḥ ekāmravane nūnaṃ naro muktimavāpnuyāt ||21|| ekāmrakaṃ gamiṣyāmi dra kṣyāmi puruṣottamam ityuccarati yasyāsye so'pi viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet ||22|| tathā tīrthāni santyajya ekāmra purūṣottamaḥ yaddhi vede purāṇe ca praṇavaḥ japyate sadā sa eva praṇavo nityaṃ bhāti pāṣāṇadehabhṛt ||23|| yadeva paramaṃ brahma brahmaloke pitāmahaḥ caturvedeṣu śāstreṣu brahmaitattacchilāṅgakam ||24|| tatra vindūdbhave snātvā yaḥ paśyanmukhapaṅkajam jīvanneva kṛtārthastu sa bhavennātra saṃśayaḥ ||25|| mukhapadmaṃ samālokya tasya śrībrahmarūpiṇaḥ sanakādyāḥ śukādyāśca paraṃ nirvāṇamāyayuḥ ||26|| kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeti gāyanti tasyāgre ye narottamāḥ bhāvanādī bhaktabandhustebhyo muktiṃ prayacchati ||27|| yastu taccaraṇodbhūtamudakaṃ pivate naraḥ bahirantargataṃ pāpaṃ tasya naśyati nānyathā ||28|| daṇḍapraṇāmaṃ kurute yastaṃ martyo janārdanam tasya satyaṃ bhavet puṇyamaśvamedhaśatodbhavam ||29|| tasya śrīvāsudevasya līlayā ca pradakṣiṇe padātpadādvinaśyanti brahma hatyā sahasraśaḥ ||30|| ekāmravipine viprā devadevo janārdanaḥ tadeva paramaṃ brahma paramānandadāyakaḥ ||31|| ekāmre paramaṃ brahma vāsudeveti saṃjñakaḥ bhaktiṃ pāṣāṇavapuṣā muktido'suranāśanaḥ ||32|| tasyāgre japenmantraṃ taṃ dhyāyan puruṣottamam sa eva yāti vaikuṇṭhaṃ naro viṣṇuparāyaṇaḥ ||33|| kṛtvā kāryyamakāryyaṃ vā dṛṣṭvaiva taṃ janārdanam naro vaikuṇṭhamāpnoti nānyathā munisattamāḥ ||34|| vāsudevasya vaikuṇṭhaṃ sthānaṃ jānītha vai dvijāḥ sarvadā tatra yastiṣṭhejjīvanmukto bhavettu saḥ ||35|| evaṃ nānāguṇāḥ santi vāsudevasya cakriṇaḥ yasya smaraṇamātreṇa brahmahatyādi gacchati ||36|| śaṅkhacakrāṅkitabhujaṃ vipinaikāmrasaṃsthitam kañjākṣaṃ pītavasanaṃ nīradābhaṃ hariṃ bhaja ||37|| iti mantraṃ japedyastu bhaktiyuktena tejasā vāsudevo dvijāḥ satyaṃ tasya muktiṃ prayacchati ||38|| sahasrayojānte ca śaṅkhacakreti yo manum bhajate durlabhāṃ muktiṃ prāpya śaṅkhadharo vrajet ||39|| mantrasyāsya dvijaśreṣṭhā upadeśo na vidyate prāṇimātreṇa jāpyaṃ ca muktidaṃ harimāvrajet ||40|| krūre bhaktivihīne ca na dātavyaḥ paro manuḥ kartavyaṃ gopanīyaṃ ca na vācyaṃ ca pare jane ||41|| śaṅkhacakramanurviprā mantrarājaḥsmṛtoḥ budhaiḥ gopanīyaḥ paro mantraḥ guhyo vaḥ kathito mayā ||42|| tasmin puṇyavane viprā liṅgaṃ brahmeśvaraṃ smṛtam tasya darśanamātreṇa brahmalokamavāpnuyāt ||43|| bhāskareśaṃ ca megheśaṃ gokarṇeśvarasaṃjñakam svarṇajāleśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ svarṇakūṭeśvaraṃ tathā ||44|| etān dṛṣṭvā namaskṛtya pūjayitvā prayatnataḥ sarvaṃ pāpaṃ parityajya kailāśanilayaṃ vrajet ||45|| āgnaye devadevasya liṅgaṃ sūkṣmeśvaraṃ dvijāḥ arcayitvā tamālokya pāparāśiṃ parityajet ||46|| tatraivāmrātakeśastu madhyameśvara eva ca etayordarśane viprā kāśīvāsaphalaṃ labhet ||47|| tatraiva piṇḍaṃ vitaran pitṝṇāṃ sūkṣmadakṣiṇe pitṝnuddhṛtya narakāddevalokaṃ vrajennaraḥ ||48|| tatra sūkṣmeśvarasthāne piṇḍadānaṃ karoti yaḥ sa karotyakṣayāṃ tṛptiṃ pitṝṇāṃ śirasā naman ||49|| viśeṣaṃ kathayiṣyāmi deśakālaṃ yathā dvijāḥ āśvine māsyamāvasyāṃ yatātmā niyataḥ śuciḥ ||50|| yaḥ kuryyātpiṇḍadānaṃ ca śrīsūkṣmeśvaradakṣiṇe pitarastasya tuṣyanti kalpakoṭiśatāntare ||51|| tasya paścimadigbhāge kapileśvarasaṃjñakaḥ sarvakāmaprado devaḥ pūjitaḥ kapilena saḥ ||52|| kapileśaṃ śubhaṃ liṅgaṃ devābhiṣṭapradāyakam prāṇināmīpsitānāṃ ca manorathaphalapradam ||53|| tatra śrīkāpilaṃ kuṇḍaṃ sarvatīrthaphalapradam tasminsnātvā vanaṃ dṛṣṭvā hyakṣayaṃ phalamāpnuyāt ||54|| tatra ugreśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ kauverīdiśamāsthitam daśalakṣaikalakṣāṇāṃ liṅgānāṃ prabhureva saḥ ||55|| taṃ dṛṣṭvā prītiyuktena lakṣaikādaśamāpnuyāt tatra nandīśvaraḥ sākṣāddevāgre bhṛkuṭīstathā ||56|| tau dṛṣṭvā ca namaskṛtya sukhamāpnoti mānavaḥ yameśvarastu tatrāste mārutīdiśamāsthitaḥ ||57|| taṃ paśyantaṃ naraṃ viprā yamadaṇḍo na bādhate tasyāgre paramaṃ tīrthaṃ pāpanāśanasaṃjñakam ||58|| pāpāni vilayaṃ yānti tajjale snānamātrataḥ mārgaśīrṣe kṛṣṇapakṣe hyaṣṭamyāṃ ca dvijottamāḥ ||59|| tatra snātvā pitṝntarpya yaḥ paśyedyamavāruṇau tasya tuṣṭo bhavecchambhuḥ kalikāle viśeṣataḥ ||60|| tatrāṣṭatīrthaṃ vidhivadyaḥ karoti narottamaḥ śivalokaṃ samāsādya na tyajetsa kadācana ||61|| kuṇḍasya dakṣiṇe bhāge īśāneśvarasaṃjñakaḥ tamāśrayitvā vidhivat padamaindra mavāpnuyāt ||62|| ekāmrakānanaṃ puṇyaṃ koṭiliṅgābhipūritam koṭitīrthasamāyuktaṃ devānāṃ jayavarddhanam ||63|| anekāni ca liṅgāni tatra santi dvijottamāḥ saṃkhyāṃ tāṃ śivaliṅgānāṃ vaktuṃ śeṣo na śaknuyāt ||64|| kaḥ śaknoti guṇān vaktuṃ kṣetrasyaikāmrakasya ca āśramāṇi ca ramyāṇi tatra santi maharṣayaḥ ||65|| kiṃcitproktaṃ mayā viprā bhavatāmihamuttamam kimanyacchraddhayā śrotumicchatha paramantapāḥ ||66|| iti śrīkapilapurāṇe ekāmrake nānāliṅgavarṇanaṃ nāma catudaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||14||
atha pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ punaḥ kimasti paramamāśramaṃ munisattama brūhi sarvamaśeṣeṇa tasminnekāmrakānane ||1|| bharadvāja uvāca tasmin puṇyavane viprā devadevasya cottare rāmeśvara iti khyāto rāmacandre ṇa pūjitaḥ ||2|| rāmacandrā śrame tacca sthānaṃ puṇyapradaṃ śubham nānāmunigaṇākīrṇaṃ brahmavāsavavanditam ||3|| bakulaiḥ panasairāmraiḥ pādapairupaśobhitam khagānekairmṛgānekaiḥ samantātparipūritam ||4|| tatsthānaṃ raghunāthasya tapovṛddhikaraṃ mahat tatrāste jānakīnātho nityamarcati taṃ śivam ||5|| tatrādhvarasamudbhūtaṃ tasya liṅgasya paścime aśokavāravikhyātaṃ tīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam ||6|| aśokādadhikaṃ tīrthaṃ nāstyatra pṛthivītale yatra snātvā naro viprā śivalokaṃ ca gacchati ||7|| yaḥ snāti tatra saṃrambhāddhyātvā hṛdi maheśvaram śuklāṣṭamyāṃ viśeṣeṇa sa pāpeṣu na līyate ||8|| diśyuttarasyāṃ vikhyātaṃ sasoścamunisattamāḥ sarvapāpaharaṃ ramyamāśramaṃ cottareśvaram ||9|| agre devyā tatheśasya japan vai saṃyatātmavān tripakṣasaṃyutaṃ ramyaṃ pūritaṃ munisattamaiḥ ||10|| aśokairnīpalodhraiśca vakulairnāgakeśaraiḥ mālatīmādhavīyuktaṃ śreṣṭhapadapasaṃyutam ||11|| tathaivāmrairāmalakaiḥ saphalairupaśobhitam karavīraiḥ karṇikāraiḥ pāṭalaiḥ sahakārakaiḥ ||12|| evaṃ nānāvidhairvṛkṣaiḥ pūritaṃ sumanoharam tatra siddheśvaraṃ liṅgamāste muktipradāyakam ||13|| madhye puṣkariṇīrūpā yamotpalasuśobhitā divyatoyā sadāpuṇyā śītalā capakardamāḥ ||14|| siddheśvaraṃ samārāghya munayaḥ paramantapāḥ prāptā caivottamā siddhi rihaloke paratra ca ||15|| siddheśvarāt paro devo na bhūto na bhaviṣyati yaṃ dṛṣṭvā mucyate pāpānnāsti brahmaghnatā nare ||16|| śirasā natadehastu praṇāmaṃ vidadhātiṃ yaḥ sa eva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ sa eva bhagavān śivaḥ ||17|| caturdaśasu lokeṣu ya siddho bhagavān śivaḥ śiva ekatvamāyāti tasmāt siddhaiśvaraḥ smṛtaḥ ||18|| taṃ dṛṣṭvā mucyate pāpaṃ spṛṣṭvā dīrghāyurāpnuyāt pūjayā muktimāpnoti satyaṃ satyaṃ mayoditam ||19|| asya dakṣiṇapārśve'sti kuṇḍaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam vikhyātaṃ tasya nāmnā tu snātvā toyaṃ sunirmalam ||20|| tatra snātvā sakṛllokaḥ nākapṛṣṭhe ca modate tatra siddheśvarasyāgre yo japenmantramuttamam ||21|| tanmantraṃ siddhidaṃ tasya samāsānnātra saṃśayaḥ tatra mukteśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ muktidaṃ pāpānāśanam ||22|| abhyāśe tasya liṅgasya taṃ dṛṣṭvā mucyate naraḥ evaṃ mayā muniśreṣṭhā gaditaṃ kṣetramuttamam ||23|| kapila uvāca śrutvetthaṃ vacanaṃ tasya bharadvājasya bho nṛpa sānandā munayaḥ sarve punaḥ papracchurādarāt ||24|| kṛtārthāśca vayaṃ sarve satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ punaḥ pṛcchā ca no jātā kṣetrasyātyantikī priyā ||25|| siddheśvarasamīpe tu yāni liṅgāni santi vai tāni no vada viprendrā yadyasti karuṇā tava ||26|| śṛṇudhvaṃ muniśārdūlā liṅgaṃ siśreśvaraṃ śubham pūrvaṃ taṃ pūjayāmāsa viḍaujāstu śacīpatiḥ ||27|| śrutvetthaṃ vacanaṃ teṣām ṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām uvāca vacanaṃ ramyaṃ bharadvājo mahāmatiḥ ||28|| bharadvāja uvāca agre siddheśvarasyātha sarvasiddhipradāyinaḥ pūrvasyāṃ diśi devasya deva indre śvaraḥ smṛtaḥ ||29|| tatra yajñaṃ cakārendraḥ sarvadevairvṛto dvijāḥ cakrurvighnaṃ ditisutāḥ kṛte yajñe viḍaujasi ||30|| cakre'sau ditidāyādaiḥ mahāyuddhaṃ balānvitaiḥ tataḥ parājitaḥ śakraḥ devānāṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ||31|| uvāca śaṅkaraṃ vīkṣya trāhi māṃ parameśvara daityaiśca nijito'haṃ vai yajñakāle jayapradaḥ ||32|| tataḥ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā mahādevo'bhyabhāṣata tvadarthaṃ hi śacīnātha śamayiṣyāmi dānavān ||33|| ityuttvā so'tivegena upasthāya tu dhūrjaṭiḥ jaghāna dānavān sarvān viṣṇunāmitavarcasā ||34|| datvā varaṃ maghone'tha tatraivāntaradhīyata tato vṛddhaśravā liṅge pūjayāmāsa śaṅkaram ||35|| sampūjya vidhivalliṅgaṃ dhūpadīpamanoharaiḥ candanena sugandhena jagāmāpyāmaravatīm ||36|| evamindre śvarotpannaṃ prakhyātaṃ ca purānaghāḥ indre śvaramāhātmyādvilayaṃ yānti kalmaṣāḥ ||37|| etadindre śvarasthānaṃ sarvapuṇyapradaṃ matam nānāmunijanākīrṇaṃ sarvavṛkṣavirājitam ||38|| ye'rcayanti tamīśānaṃ bhaktāstu narasattamāḥ pretya te yānti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yaddevadurlabham ||39|| ye'rcayanti tamīśānamapi durbāṅkurairnarāḥ te yānti vimalaṃ sthānaṃ bhāsamānāḥ sutejasaḥ ||40|| itthamindre śvarākhyānaṃ kathitaṃ munisattamāḥ sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ paramaṃ svastyayanaṃ mahat ||41|| ya idaṃ śṛṇuyādārṣaṃ vācakaṃ ca na pūjayet cakṣuṣī tasya karṇau ca badhirībhavato dvijāḥ ||42|| tasmātphalaiśca vastraiśca taṃ svarṇaiśca prapūjayet evamindra śvaro nūnaṃ svabhakteṣu prasīdati ||43|| iti śrīkapilapurāṇe indre śvarākhyānaṃ nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||15||
atha ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ bharadvāja uvāca atha vakṣye mahāpuṇyaṃ namaskṛtya maheśvaram dakṣiṇe siddhināthasya kedāreśvarasaṃjñakam ||1|| kedāreśasthalīṃ prāpya naro bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ pūjayitvā maheśānamāpnuyātphalamīpsitam ||2|| dakṣiṇāmūrtināmā'sau sarvasiddhipradāyakaḥ phalantu darśanenāsya vājapeyāśvamedhayoḥ ||3|| liṅgasya paścime caiva dakṣiṇe cottare tathā sadā sevanti yo'ntaśca punātyakhilabhūrbhuvam ||4|| yo naro vā śiro'myukṣya naraḥ śivaparāyaṇaḥ duritaṃ nāśayatyāśu kedāreśaprasādataḥ ||5|| tasyāṃ sthalyāṃ tu devyāste gaurītrailokyasundarī viśeṣato yugaprānte sādhakānāṃ varapradā ||6|| trayāṇāṃ jagatāṃ mātā gaurīrūpeṇa saṃsthitā tasyāstu darśane rājan lokanāthaḥ prasīdati ||7|| enāmāsādayeddevīṃ mantrāṇāṃ phalarūpiṇīm yāmupāsya purā rājā nahuṣo'bhūnmahītale ||8|| sā tatraiva purā cakre kuṇḍaṃ kedārasaṃjñakam viviktaṃ nirmalajalaṃ sopattipadasaṃyutam ||9|| vindūdbhave tanutyāgāt śrīsūkṣme piṇḍadānataḥ kedāre udakaṃ pītvā punarjanma na vidyate ||10|| navamyāmasite pakṣe mūrdhni datvā'mitaṃ phalam snātvā tasmin hrade viprāḥ kimvā na labhate naraḥ ||11|| tatra śrīdakṣiṇāmūrteragre pīṭho mahān smṛtaḥ tava pīṭheti vikhyātaḥ sādhakanāṃ phalapradaḥ ||12|| naktavrataṃ samāsthāya saṃyatātmā jitendri yaḥ japtvā trayodaśāhena mantrasiddhimavāpnuyāt ||13|| yasya kedārake sthāne mantrasiddhirna jāyate viṃśatijanmanā tasya siddhirna syātkathañcana ||14|| kedārasthānamāsādya kiñcijjaptvā munīśvarāḥ na naro narakaṃ yāti satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||15|| snātvā kedārake tīrthe dṛṣṭvā gaurīṃ maheśvaram sakṛjjaptvā bhavaṃtpīṭhe kṛtakṛtyo bhavennaraḥ ||16|| kathayāmi purāvṛtaṃ kedāre tatra vai dvijāḥ śrutvā pāpaṃ parityajya puṇyarāśiṃ gamiṣyatha ||17|| dakṣasatre pravṛtte ca bāsavādyāśca devatāḥ havirbhāgaṃ vibhuñjanti dattaṃ devāmahīśvarāḥ ||18|| tadā dākṣāyaṇī devī jñātvā patyurvigarhitam praviveśa svayaṃ vahnau bharturbhaktiparāyaṇā ||19|| tato maheśvaro devo dakṣayajñaṃ vyanāśayat palāyantesma devāśca bhayādrudra sya kalpitāḥ ||20|| kṛttivāsāḥ jagāmātha himavantaṃ nageśvaram tataśca tārakenāpi kāmena sarvapuṣṭidam ||21|| sā'pi sādhvī himavato jātā kamalalocanā pūjayāmāsa taṃ devaṃ preṣitā janakena ca ||22|| kandarpastatra gatvā ca brahmaṇyasya tapasvinaḥ pārvatīsammukhaṃ devaṃ preṣayāmāsa kārmukān ||23|| dhṛte dhanuṣi kāmena saśare kṛttivāsasaḥ tṛtīyacakṣuṣo vahniḥ papāta madanopari ||24|| dagdhakāmaśarīro'sau mahādevo jagadguruḥ jñātvā nārāyaṇīṃ devīṃ upayeme samādhinā ||25|| tato nage himavati tasthau devo maheśvaraḥ pārvatyā saha sa devo vijahāra yathāsukham ||26|| menovācā'tha tanayāṃ sthānaṃ nāstyapi kiṃ tava yuvāṃ saṃgacchatāṃ sthānaṃ tavaitatsukhadaṃ na hi ||27|| strīṇāṃ pitṛgṛhe vāso ninditavyaḥ punaḥ punaḥ jānataivaṃ bhavennindā na stheyaṃ śvaśuragṛhe ||28|| iti śrutvā haimavatī kopaprasphuritādharā bahudhā vilapantī sā bhavāyedaṃ jagāda ha ||29|| īśvarastvaṃ mahābāho sarvaśaktisamanvitaḥ sthātuṃ sthānaṃ na me āste kimetaddhi bhavadgṛhe ||30|| devadeva tavādeśātsthānamekañca kalpaya kṛśānuretāḥ tatsthāṇuḥ sthānaṃ saṃtyajya satvaram yayau sarvagaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ madhyadeśaṃ tadā śivaḥ ||31|| pūrvasāgaragaminyā gaṅgāyā uttare taṭe vārāṇasīṃ nāgapurīṃ nirmame pārvatīhite ||32|| tatra tiṣṭhan jagannātho nāradaṃ paryapṛcchat ekāntaṃ paramaṃ puṇyaṃ kutrāraṇyaṃ mahāmune ||33|| vārāṇasyāṃ mama prītirtato nindāpyanekadhā gaṅgā sakalapāpaghnī yatrāste marṇikarṇikā ||34|| vārāṇsyāṃ tanutyāgādbrahmavidyā va bodhanāt dvābhyāmeva bhavenmuktiḥ nātsyanyanmuktikāraṇam ||35|| iyaṃ bahujānākīrṇā babhūva munisattama ato mano na ramate mama nārada niścitam ||36|| ityuktvā nāradenāsau sa yayāvāmrakaṃ vanam liṅgarūpadharastasthau natvā śrīpurūṣottamam ||37|| jñātvā tatsarvavṛtāntaṃ himavān parvatādhipaḥ strībhiḥ sarvaparivṛto mainākena ca menayā ||38|| gaṅgayā lokapāvanyā munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ ājagāma vanaśreṣṭhamāśramaṃ munisattamāḥ ||39|| vindutīrthegirauḥsnātvā dṛṣṭvā nārāyaṇaṃ harim devasya dvāramāsādya stauti stutyā'nayā tadā ||40|| hemabāhuruvāca ādikanda namastubhyaṃ namaste'vyaktayonaye kāmacāraṇasiṃhāya sarvepsitapradāya ca ||41|| bhaktapriyaḥ namastubhyaṃ viṣṇucakrapradāya ca tripuraghnaḥ namastestu nānāsuravaraprada ||42|| nāgārjunasahāyastvaṃ kāśīrājavaraprada vidyāgoptā lokasākṣī andhakadīpakeśarī ||43|| namo mokṣapradātre ca bhagīrathavaraprada nīlakaṇṭha namastubhyamumāpriyakṛte namaḥ ||44|| namaste saccidānanda kumāragurave namaḥ rāmacandra pratiṣṭhātre pañca brahma namo'stute ||45|| kṣetreśaparameśāna hyaparādhaḥ kuto mayā idānīṃ karuṇāpaṅgaiḥ pūrayasva manoratham ||46|| iti stutvā bahubhiḥ vacobhirnīlalohitam papāta bhūbhṛtāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ tadā sa avanītale ||47|| tato dṛṣṭvā girivaramamṛtākṣarabhāṣiṇam stutvā namreṇa santuṣṭo mahādevo'bhyabhāṣata ||48|| kimicchasi giriśreṣṭha kiṃ hi kāmaṃ yathepsitam santuṣṭo varado'haṃ ca stotreṇānena vā'nagha ||49|| iti śrutvā vacastasya dhūrjaṭeḥ himavāṃstadā vadhvāñjaliṃ karapuṭe vācamūce priyambadām ||50|| asmin kṣetre jagannātha tvadīyaṃ liṅgamuttamam didṛkṣurasmi tatrāhaṃ prasādaṃ kuru dhūrjaṭe ||51|| yato me veśma saṃtyajya āgatastvaṃ sahomayā ato didṛkṣuḥ strīṃ sādhvīmāgato'haṃ tvadālayam ||52|| etasyāṃ mahatīṃ prītiṃ pṛṣṭvā vandhu janasya me jāyate mahatī prītiranurāgo vivardhate ||53|| adhunā bahubhiḥ ratnaiḥ prāsādaṃ karavāṇi te ājñāpaya maheśāna yadyasti karuṇā mayi ||54|| girīndra matha deveśo vākyametaduvāca ha durlabhaṃ devatābhiśca kiṃ tvayā proṣitaṃ gire ||55|| brahmaṇā viṣṇunetreṇa anena varuṇena ca prāsādastu hyasādhyo'yaṃ kalau candraḥ kariṣyati ||56|| idānīṃ matsamaṃ liṅgaṃ kedāreśvarasaṃjñakam siddheśvarasamīpe ca prasādaṃ kuru suvrata ||57|| tatrā'haṃ sarvabhāvena sādhakānāṃ varapradaḥ tatra te tanayā gaurī hyasmatprītivivarddhinī ||58|| āste lokopakārāya kratuṃ kṛtvā svapāṇinā rūpaṃ saumyapradaṃ sūkṣmaṃ viviktaṃ sumanoharam ||59|| mantreṇānena vidhivad vibhajyotkuṇḍavāriṇi gaurī kṛtaḥ namastubhyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam ||60|| pāpāpanodaṃ kuru me nimajje'haṃ tavāmbhasi ityuktvā trīṇi vārīṇi nimajjeta tu vāriṇi ||61|| kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā devastotramudīrayet dakṣiṇāmūrtaye tubhyaṃ vaṭamūlanivāsine ||62|| dhyānaikaniratāṅgāya namo rudrā ya te namaḥ ||63|| evaṃ yaḥ kurute dhīmān śucistadgatamānasaḥ kailāsabhuvanaṃ yāti sa naro nātra saṃśayaḥ ||64|| navamyāṃ śuklapakṣasya iṣe māsi viśeṣataḥ datvā kṛṣṇa tilān mūrdhni yo majjetpārvatīhrade ||65|| sa yātyākhaṇḍalasthānaṃ vimānena virājitaḥ śucirūrdhvagatistatra brahmaṇaḥ sadanaṃ param ||66|| gaccha tatra giriśreṣṭha kuruṣvācamanaṃ mama pūjayasva prayatnena madīyaṃ liṅgamuttamam ||67|| vācamityeva sa prāha girīśaṃ prahasanniva yāsye tadvacanaṃ śambho karavāṇi na saṃśayaḥ ||68|| ityuktvā gotrarājā'sau prāsādaṃ bahuvistṛtam prāṅgaṇaiḥ vitatairyuktaṃ toraṇaiśca samantataḥ ||70|| bahukośaprapūrṇañca chatravyajanasaṅkulam cakāra vidhivatprājño yena tuṣyati śaṅkaraḥ ||71|| pūjāṃ tatra maheśasya kṛtvā stutvā praṇamya ca tadādi kṛtakṛtyo'bhūt samastairbāndhavairvṛtaḥ ||72|| tato gandhavatīnāmmīṃ gaṃgāṃ cātra visṛjya ca yayau gotrakulaśreṣṭhaḥ svasthānaṃ haramuktaye ||73|| etattīrthavaramaṃ viprā śrutamaṃ trailokya pāvanam sarvapāpaghnamatulamaṃ munīnāṃ prītivardhanam ||74|| yo'sau vai dakṣiṇāmūrtiḥ maheśasya prakīrtitā tattulyā karmabhūmau ca phaladā nāsti devatā ||75|| tasyaiva sannidhānena rudra liṅgavaraḥ svayam nāmabhiḥ pūjitaścāyaṃ nāmaśāntiśiveti vā ||76|| dṛṣṭvā śāntaśivaṃ viprā sarvaśāntimavāpnuyāt śāntātmā vijitātmā ca yāti satyaṃ śivālayam ||77|| nāmnā śāntāśivoliṅgo dakṣiṇāmūrtirityasau enaṃ pūjya namaskṛtya śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt ||78|| kedāreśvaramākhyānaṃ ca idaṃ kīrtayennaraḥ śṛṇuyādvā naro yastu tasya vai śāśvatī gatiḥ ||79|| iti śrīkapilapurāṇe kedāre himavadāgamanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||16||
saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ purā himavatā tyaktā tatra gandhasaritkatham etanno vada viprarṣe kāmadaṃ sarvamaṅgalam ||1|| tasyāstīre parvatāśca liṅgāni vividhāni ca brūhi nastīrthayuktāni phaladānānyaśeṣataḥ ||2|| bharadvāja uvāca kathayāmi muniśreṣṭhā yūyaṃ yatparipṛcchatha śṛṇu taikamanoyuktā yadi śraddhā ca vartate ||3|| na santi triṣu lokeṣu nadyo gandhavatīsamāḥ yasyā darśanamātreṇa naro mucyeta kalmaṣāt ||4|| ādādya yāṃ purā viprā yayuḥ saptarṣayo divam pāvanīṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ tāṃ nadīṃ ko na saṃśrayet ||5|| ājagāma yadā viprā himavān pārvatādhipaḥ tadā'tra devaṃ sampūjya kedāreśvaramuttamam ||6|| kṣmābhṛtprabhuḥ kṛtārthātmā talliṅgārcanajaiḥ sukhaiḥ nanandāramuvācedaṃ jāhnavīṃ giriśapriyām ||7|| gaṅge bhāgīrathīnāmnā yathā''khyāsti tavācyute tathā
