sthāpitapāpaghne tvamatra sthitimācara ||10|| gaṅgā ca navadhā proktā hyadhunā daśadhā bhava brahmahatyādipāpānāṃ nāśinīpuṇyavarddhinī ||11|| ādyā godāvarī gaṅgā dvitīyā yā punaḥ punaḥ tṛtīyā kathitā revā caturthī jāhnavī smṛtā ||12|| kāverī pañcamī proktā ṣaṣṭhī vai gomatī tathā kṛṣṇā ca saptamī proktā brāhmī hyaṣṭamyudāhṛtā ||13|| namavī vai vaitaraṇī navadhā ceti viśrutā adhunaikāmrake devi saśarīrā tava śubhe ||14|| godāvarī gomatī ca kṛṣṇā caiva punaḥ punaḥ brāhmī revā ca kāverī tathā vaitaraṇī smṛtā ||15|| jāhnavī ca tataḥ proktā tato gaṅgā mahāsarit ityetā daśadhārā ca kṣetre'smin tu surārcite ||16|| iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā gaṅgovāca himālayam yūyaṃ me guravastāta karavāṇi vacastava ||17|| khyātiṃ cātra gamiṣyāmi kena nāmnā girīśvara tannāma vada māṃ śīghraṃ yadyevaṃ prītirastite ||18|| himavānuvāca kānanodbhavapuṣpāṇāṃ ketakīnāṃ latāntare keśarāṇāṃ ca padmānāṃ campakānāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||19|| phalānāṃ vāyusaṃsargādgandhalābhādmahītale nāmnā gandhavatī gaṅge bhavaikāmravane śubhe ||20|| ata eva mama prītirbhavitā mahatī tvayi śaṅkarastvayi santuṣṭo bhavitā nātra saṃśayaḥ ||21|| vācamityeva sā prāha himavantaṃ nagottamam vavāha dakṣiṇe gaṅgā sāgaraṃ kānanāntare ||22|| tato vai puṣpavṛṣṭistu śakrādikarasaṃcyutā papāta himavanmūrdhni devadundubhipūrvakam ||23|| kṛtakṛtyastato grīvo jagāma svāśramaṃ dvijāḥ gaṅgā gandhavatī nāmnā dakṣiṇārṇavagāminī ||24|| evaṃ mayā nigaditā gaṇānāṃ tveti mantreṇa vighnarājaṃ samarcayet ||75|| vighnarājaṃ samarcyātha ekameśvarasannidhau yathākāmena saṃkalpya tataḥ kuryātsa vai vratī ||76|| tataḥ pratidinaṃ viprāḥ snānaṃ kuryāt hradottame darśanaṃ pratyahaṃ kuryādvratī śrīkīrtivāsasaḥ ||77|| devyāśca pādaharayoḥ tathā'nantasya bhodvijāḥ bhedaṃ na kārayeddhīmān brāhmaṇaḥ kīrtivāsasaḥ ||78|| eṣāntu darśanaṃ kuryātpratyahaṃ vratināmvaraḥ varjayetprathame māsi śākaṃ vigatamatsaraḥ ||79|| dadhivarjaṃ bhādra pade āśvine varjayet payaḥ kārttike māsi samprāpte varjyo māṃso dvijottamāḥ ||80|| dīpadānantu vai kuryāt śira uddiśya prayaham sa tu striyaṃ na saṃvīkṣedvarjayettailamāmiṣam ||81|| gate tu kārtike māse saṃdīkṣyā vratacāriṇaḥ kṣudhārtibhyo'nnadānañca kartavyaṃ vratinā sadā ||82|| anyatīrthādviśiṣṭaṃ hi puṇyaṃ nūnamudāhṛtam tasmādannapradakṣetre muktiḥ tasya kare sthitā ||83|| annaṃ pratidinaṃ viprāḥ dātavyaṃ puṇyamicchatā sarvantu viphalaṃ tasya kṣetrek'smin vimukhe tithau ||84|| sarvadānādannadānaṃ viśeṣaṃ samudāhṛtam tasmādviprāḥ kṣetravare hyannadaḥ sarvadānadaḥ ||85|| annadānātparaṃ dānaṃ na bhūto na bhaviṣyati gajāśvarathadānebhyo hyannadānaṃ viśiṣyate ||86|| annadaṃ sarvadaṃ prāhuḥ pūrvaṃ vidyāvicakṣaṇāḥ annadānaṃ sadā kāle kartavyaṃ śivasadmani ||87|| cāturmāsyavrataṃ viprā ya evaṃ kurute pumān nārī vātha dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ sa phalaṃ labhate dhruvam ||88|| dine dine'śvamedhasya phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ rājasūyasya yajñasya kārtike samudāhṛtam ||89|| dharmārthakāmamokṣārthaṃ samāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ vedajño brāhmaṇo dhīmān rājā ca vijayī bhavet ||90|| vaiśyo dhanasamṛddhaḥ syāt śūdraḥ sadgatimāpnuyāt anyakṣetre kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ śivasadmani nāśayet ||91|| brahmahatyādipāpāni anyakṣetre kṛtāni ca kṣayamāyānti kṣetre'smin praviṣṭe narasattama ||92|| anyakṣetre kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ svarṇakūṭe vinaśyati svarṇakūṭe kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vajralepaṃ bhaveddhruvam ||93|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ asminkṣetre kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vajralepaṃ bhavediti tvayoktaṃ yaddvijaśreṣṭha tatkṣayaṃ kena vā bhavet ||94|| bharadvāja uvāca māghe māse kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ dvijottamāḥ kṣetre pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryādyo naraḥ saṃyatātmavān ||95|| devasya dakṣiṇe pūrve paścime cottare tathā krośamātraṃ paraṃ kṣetraṃ śivasya parameṣṭhinaḥ ||96|| pradakṣiṇañca yaḥ kuryādmeruṃ sūryaharaṃ dvijāḥ tasya kṣetraṃ kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vinaśyati na saṃśayaḥ ||97|| tatra maunī bhaveddhīmānkuryādanaśanavratam dinenaikena vai kuryāttatra sarvaṃ pradakṣiṇam ||98|| naiva tiṣṭhetkṣaṇamapi na hāsaṃ naiva rodanam hāse ca rodane viprā viphalaṃ vai pradakṣiṇam ||99|| pradakṣiṇena kṣetrasya koṭijanmāghanāśanam dvitīyena dvitīyasya tṛtīyena trijanmanā ||100|| ekāmrakṛtapāpānāṃ kṣayāya dvijasattamāḥ kṣetrapradakṣiṇāccātra nānyaḥ panthāstu vidyate ||101|| anyatīrthe kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ svarṇakūṭe vinaśyati svarṇakūṭe kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vinaśyati pradakṣiṇe ||102|| iti śrīkapilapurāṇe bharadvāja ṛṣisamvāde cāturmāsyavratavidhānaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||18||
athaikonaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ asmin kṣetre dvijaśreṣṭha yātrā yatra samīritāḥ saṃkṣepeṇa tu tā sarvāstvamasmānkathaya prabho ||1|| bharadvāja uvāca tasminnekāmrakavane sapta yātrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ahaṃ tāḥ kathayiṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ munipuṅgavāḥ ||2|| mārgaśīrṣe kṛṣṇapakṣe yā syātprathamamaṣṭamī tatra yātrā samuddiṣṭā devadenena śambhunā ||3|| ājñāṃ varuṇabhūpāya purā śambhuḥ pradattavān samīpaṃ tava liṅgasya yāsyāmi prathamāṣṭamī ||4|| tataḥ prabhṛti bhoviprā yātraikā prathamāṣṭamī tatra snānaṃ japo dānaṃ sarvaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam ||5|| atha nāmnā'bhidhāsyāmi yātrāṃ pāpavināśinīm bhāskarāya purā viprā ājñāṃ datvā tu śambhunā ||6|| śṛṇudhvaṃ madvaco rājantava prītyāvadāmyaham māghaśuklasya saptamyāṃ yātrā pāpavināśinī ||7|| tasyāṃ tithau sahasrāṃśostava liṅgasya sannidhim yāsyāmi ca pradāsyāmi lokānāṃ phalamuttamam ||8|| tiladānaṃ tu tatroktaṃ mahāpuṇyapradāyakam tatra śrībhāskareśasya pūjanaṃ muktilakṣaṇam ||9|| tathā'nyacca pravakṣyāmi kapilasya mahātmanaḥ liṅgasya sannidhānañca devadevasya śūlinaḥ ||10|| kapile pūjite liṅge varo dattaḥ kapardinā tatrā'haṃ sarvabhāvena pūjāṃ gṛhṇāmi vai mune ||11|| phālgunasya site pakṣe yadā syāt sauravāsaraḥ tatra yātrāṃ kariṣyāmi śubhayā ca sahomayā ||12|| prāṇināṃ tu pradāsyāmi vācchitaṃ phalamuttamam pavitre kāpile śretre bhoktṝṇāñca viśeṣataḥ ||13|| tailaṃ datvā śirogātramajjanaṃ kāpile hrade mantreṇānena vidhivattatra snānaṃ samācaret ||14|| namaḥ kapilatīrthāṅgaṃ gaṅgāmbudhiphalapradam pāpaṃ nāśaya me tīrtha majjaye'haṃ tavāmbhasi ||15|| iti mantraṃ samuccārya tatra snānaṃ samācaret brahmahatyādipāpāni nāśayennātra saṃśayaḥ ||16|| evamuktvā tu bhagavān tatraivāntaradhīyata athānyayātrāṃ vakṣyāmi aśokāsyāṃ mahāphalām ||17|| rādhavāya purā viprāḥ prasanno bhagavānabhūt uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ vākyajñaścottamaujasām ||18|| rāma rāma mahābāho madvākyaṃ śṛṇu rāghava mokṣāya sarvabhūtānāṃ vakṣye yātrāṃ mahāphalām ||19|| caitre māsi ca samprāpte yadā śuklāṣṭamī bhavet yāmye girijayā sārddhaṃ mama liṅgasya sannidhau ||20|| rathasthaṃ tatra māṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmahatyādipātakaiḥ mucyate nā'tra sandehastvapi cāṇḍālayonitaḥ ||21|| tataḥ prabhṛti bho viprā aśokāsyā mahāphalā athānyāñca pravakṣyāmi yātrāṃ vai madanāntikām ||22|| caitraśuklacaturdaśyāṃ madanenārcayacchivam sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śivalokaṃ vrajeddhruvam ||23|| viśeṣaṇa tu kartavyā śrītīrtheśvarasannidhau yātrāmathānyāṃ vakṣye'haṃ prabho rāmasya sannidhau ||24|| rāmeṇa pūjitaṃ yacca śrīrāmeśvarasaṃjñakam tadeva liṅgaṃ rāmasya yāmadagnasya sammatam ||25|| āṣāḍhasya ca śuklāyāmaṣṭamyāṃ parikīrtitā yāmadagnāya rāmāya purā dattavaro haraḥ ||26|| prāṇināṃ prāṇanāśāya yāsye'haṃ tava sannidhau athānyāmabhidhāsyāmi dvitīyākhyām̐ mahāphalām ||27|| śuklapakṣe dvitīyāyāṃ kārtikasya viśeṣataḥ yātrā kāmapradā viprāḥ śrīyameśvarasannidhau ||28|| ityeṣāṃ saptamī yātrā kathitā sā mahāvratāḥ tataḥ kimadhikaṃ viprāḥ purāṇaṃ śrotumicchatha ||29|| kapila uvāca tasyoktamidamākarṇya bharadvājasya te tadā ānandāśrujalairyuktā gamanaṃ cakrire vanam ||30|| ādye ca divase sarve yayurvārāṇasīṃ purīm snātvā ca jāhnavītoye dadṛśurliṅgamuttamam ||31|| tataste harṣamatulamāvāpurmunisattamāḥ punastaṃ pūjayāmāsa devadevaṃ maheśvaram ||32|| dvitīye divase caiva gaṅgāṃ prāpurmahīsurāḥ piṇḍadānādikaṃ tatra gādādharakare kṛtam ||33|| tato bahudine te ca prāpurvirajamaṇḍalām snātvā vaitaraṇītoye dadṛśuḥ koparūpiṇam ||34|| tataste virajāṃ devīṃ devaṃ mukteśvaraṃ haram akhaṇḍaleśvarañcaiva trilocanamaheśvaram ||35|| tato brāhmīṃ nadīṃ prāpuḥ pūrvasāgaragāminīm sarvapāpakṣayakarīṃ snānaṃ cakre dvijottamāḥ ||36|| tṛtīye divase rājan yayurekāmrakaṃ vanam tatra gatvā muniśreṣṭhāḥ āśramāṇi vilokya ca ||37|| siddhāśramaṃ samāśritya mudaṃ prāpurmahīpate evaṃ tīrthe nṛpaśreṣṭha variṣṭhe puṣkare purā ||38|| ṛṣīṇāṃ caiva samvādaṃ bharadvājena dhīmatā kathitaṃ tacca tuṣṭyarthamutkalaṃ deśamuttamam ||39|| idānīñca mahīpāla kimanyacchrotumicchasi ya idaṃ paramaṃ puṇyaṃ mahātmyaṃ cotkalasya ca ||40|| śṛṇoti hṛṣṭaromā sa puṇyāṃ gatimāpnuyāt ya idañcotkalākhyānaṃ paṭhen mānavasattamaḥ ||41|| sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ devādīnāñca durlabham utkalasya ca māhātmyaṃ ye śṛṇvanti mahīpate ||42|| gosahasrapradānasya te narāḥ phalamāpnuyuḥ yastvidaṃ paramaṃ puṇyaṃ karoti narasattamaḥ ||43|| tasya dharme sthitā buddhiḥ na calettu kadācana ||44|| iti śrīkapilapurāṇe bharadvājarṣisamvāde devānāṃ muktiprāptirnāma ekonaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||19||
atha viṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ satyajiduvāca śrutāḥ purātanā dharmā nadīnāṃ varṇanāni ca śrutvā tīrthānyanekāni pāpaṃ me vilayaṃ gataḥ ||1|| śrīkapila uvāca saphalāni ca kṣetrāṇi kathitāni mayā purā idānīṃ kathayiṣyāmi śṛṇu tvamavanīpate ||2|| kathitā yā purā rājan bahvaghaghnī mahānadī tasyāstu tanayā'khyātā dakṣiṇe dakṣiṇāgamā ||3|| sā nadī bhṛguṇā''nītā tapasā ca mahātmanā tataḥ sā bhārgavī khyātā gosahasraphalapradā ||4|| siddheśvarī samāsācca tathāsiddheśvarīvadhe bhārgavī bhṛguṇā''nītā gaṅgāsamaphalapradā ||5|| tasyāstaṭe mahīpāla yatra syācchivaliṅgakam tatra sā mokṣadā khyātā hyābhimukhye viśeṣataḥ ||6|| snānamantraṃ nibodha tvaṃ puṇyaṃ nṛpatisattama viphalaṃ bhavati snānaṃ snānamantramṛte yataḥ ||7|| bhṛgukanye namastubhyaṃ gosahasraphalaprade pāpāni vilayaṃ yāntu majjane tava vāriṇi ||8|| ityuktvā majjeyettasyāṃ tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ prāpnoti paramaṃ sthānamekaviṃśatipūruṣaiḥ ||9|| tasyāstu tanayā rājan puṣyabhadre ti viśrutā pūrvasyāṃ diśi sā khyātā pūrvasāgaragāminī ||10|| tasyāṃ snānaṃ mahīpāla kārtike sarvakāmadam tathā māghe tathā''ṣāḍhe phālgune ca viśeṣataḥ ||11|| puṣyabhadrā nadī yā tu sā kṛṣṇā nātrasaṃśayaḥ śamvaraṃ nirmalaṃ yasyā vāñchanti pitṛdevatāḥ ||12|| tasyā duhitaramanyāṃ pravekṣya bhūbhṛtāmvara dadhinādeti vikhyātā ekāmravanasannidhau ||13|| ānītā ṛṣiṇā cāsau tāpasena dadhīcinā tajjale snānamātreṇa somalokaṃ vrajennaraḥ ||14|| tatraiva dṛśyate liṅgaṃ vyomakeśasya bhūpate taṭe tasyāḥ prayatnena tatra snānaṃ samācaret ||15|| anyasnānācchataguṇaṃ sahasraguṇitaṃ phalam prāpnotyabhimataṃ kāmaṃ snānakṛnnarasattama ||16|| mahīpāla śṛṇuṣvaṃ tvaṃ prācīṃ guptasarasvatīm yayā kālāgninā dagdhaṃ rakṣitaṃ sacarācaram ||17|| ekāmrakānanātpūrve yojanānte mahīpate nāmnā prācīti vikhyātā saridāste sarasvatī ||18|| prācyāṃ diśi maheśasya yatra sāgarasaṅgamaḥ krośe krośe taṭe liṅgaṃ tataḥ prācī sarasvatī ||19|| tasyāṃ snātvā mahīpāla jyotirlokaṃ vrajennaraḥ sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ saptaviṃśatipūruṣaiḥ ||20|| sarvapuṇyapradā mānyā vaikuṇṭhabhavanapradā sākṣāt sarasvatī prācī nānyasyāṃ nṛpasattama ||21|| krośe krośe ca liṅgāni taṭe tasyā manorame sarvatra sukhasañcāre vidvajanasusevite ||22|| tatra vighnevaro nāma vighnamūlāśrito haraḥ taṃ dṛṣṭvā pūjayitvā ca naraḥ śivamavāpnuyāt ||23|| vighnaśākhī mahīpāla kalpavṛkṣasamo bhuvi tasya pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā mucyate brahmahatyayā ||24|| triveṇīsaṅgamaṃ tatra mahāpuṇyapradāyakam tatra snānaṃ mahīpāla māghamāse prakīrtitam ||25|| viśeṣeṇa pravakṣyāmi amāvasyāphalaṃ mahat snānaṃ sandhyātapodānamakṣayaṃ tu samīritam ||26|| prācyāṃ tu pāṇḍave tīrthe snānaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ sa pāpakṣayamādatte śivasālokyatāṃ vrajet ||27|| mahalliṅgaṃ pravakṣye'haṃ tattaṭe hyamareśvaram amareśaṃ samālokya na naro bhavatāmiyāt ||28|| tasyāstaṭe maheśastu kapileśvarasaṃjñakaḥ sarvapāpaharo devastalliṅgaṃ pūjitaṃ mayā ||29|| evaṃ bahūni liṅgāni santi tasyāstaṭe śubhe kaḥ śaknoti guṇān vaktuṃ tasyāḥ prācyāḥ mahīpate ||30|| saṃkṣepeṇa mayā'khyātaṃ tvatprasaṅgācca pṛcchataḥ ||31|| satyajiduvāca utkalasya ca māhātmyaṃ śrutañca sakalaṃ mayā ||32|| idānīñca muniśreṣṭha jñānayogaṃ vadasva me ||33|| iti śrīkapilapurāṇe utkalamāhātmyavarṇane viṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||20||
athaikaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ kapila uvāca jñānayogaṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ kathayāmi narādhipa śṛṇuṣvaikamanā bhūtvā yadi śraddhā pravarttate ||1|| nandikeśvarasamvāde devadevena śambhunā purā śrutaṃ mayā bhūya idānīṃ śṛṇu cānagha ||2|| namaste pārvatīnātha bhaktānāṃ karuṇākara kathaṃ vimucyate jantuḥ saṃsārātkarmabandhanāt ||3|| mahādeva uvāca kāmaṃ krodhaṃ parityajya yo jantuḥ bhajate hi mām parāṃ muktiṃ prayacchāmi tamahaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||4|| kāmakrodhau yadā putra parityajati mānavaḥ tadā'sya ca hṛdistho'yaṃ prakāśamadhigacchati ||5|| putradārasamāyuktā ye cānandanti mānavāḥ na jānanti paraṃ jyotiḥ hṛdayaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ||6|| damena mohitānāryā ye krīḍanti narādhamāḥ teṣāṃ nirayavāsañca satyaṃ satyaṃ mahoditam ||7|| kāmaṃ krodhaṃ madaṃ mohaṃ hiṃsāṃ paiśunyameva ca ahaṅkāraṃ tathā lobhaṃ tyaja tvaṃ nandikeśvara ||8|| karmaṇā mānasā vācā saṃkalpaṃ tyajate tu yaḥ harināmajapenaiva bhavābdhiṃ tarate tu saḥ ||9|| harināmāmṛtañcāsye kṛtvā vaiṣṇavasattamaḥ ataḥ sarvamavāmbhodhikāmasaṅkalpavarjitāḥ ||10|| hariryathā jagannāthastathā'haṃ jagatāṃ patiḥ āvayorantaraṃ nāsti ākāśe pavanaṃ yathā ||11|| harernāma harernāma kīrtayasva nirantaram dadāti paramāṃ muktiṃ sāyujyaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||12|| viśvāsaḥ kriyatāṃ tasmin harau trailokyanāyake yasya māyāsamāviṣṭo brahmā bhramati sarvadā ||13|| jagadupari govinde mayi vātasvarūpiṇi kuru bhaktiṃ dṛḍhāṃ putra mokṣyase dṛḍhabandhanāt ||14|| mayāpi cāryase nā'haṃ karomi ca karoti ca śaṅkaraḥ nīlakaṇṭhaśca śrīdharo nīlavigrahaḥ ||15|| gaurīśo gopikākāntaḥ dhyāyatāmekacetasā mādhavasyomādhavasya kiñcidbhedo na vidyate ||16|| mūḍhā bhedaṃ prakurvanti prapacyante hi raurave ||17|| kapila uvāca ityuktvā bhagavān śambhuḥ tatastūṣṇīmbabhūva ha evaṃ te pārvatīnāthaṃ nandī punarabhāṣata ||18|| vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca cihnāni tasya viṣṇormahātmanaḥ tato'haṃ śrotumicchāmi vada māṃ karuṇākara ||19|| śaṅkhacakrāṅkitaṃ dehaṃ tulasīdāmabhūṣitam śrīmahādeva uvāca kāma krodhaparityaktaṃ cihnaṃ vaiṣṇavasaṃjñakam ||20|| eṣāṃ kaupīnakaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mukhe ca madhuraṃ vacaḥ sarvadānandahṛdayaṃ cihnaṃ vaiṣṇavasaṃjñakam ||21|| ānandāśrusamāyuktamuccairgovindakīrtanam asaṅgasya parityāgaścihnaṃ vaiṣṇavasaṃjñakam ||23|| sarvasvaṃ nāma buddhitvaṃ sarvasattvasukhāvaham dayāsatyasamāyuktaṃ cihnaṃ vaiṣṇavasaṃjñakam ||24|| nirmamaṃ nirahaṅkāraṃ devatābrāhmaṇārcanam satāṃ samprītijananaṃ cihnaṃ vaiṣṇavasaṃjñakam ||25|| evaṃ vaiṣṇavacihnāni yasya santi sa vaiṣṇavaḥ anye ye dambhikā lubdhā teṣāṃ liṅgaṃ na kāraṇam ||26|| ityuktvā bhagavān śambhurgaurīkrīḍāguhāntaram pratīhārī tvasau nandī tatrāste dhṛtadaṇḍakaḥ ||27|| nandikeśvarasamvādamevaṃ devena śambhunā sarvaśāntikaraṃ puṇyaṃ guhyaṃ te kathitaṃ mayā ||28|| avaiṣṇave na vācyastu devabrāhmaṇanindakaiḥ jñānayogo manomale na vācyaṃ saṃśayātmani ||29|| ya idaṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ jñānayogaṃ paṭhennaraḥ śṛṇuyādapi yo bhaktyā sa śāntimadhigacchati ||30|| iti śrīkapilapurāṇe utkalakṣetropākhyāne catuḥkṣetramāhātmyaṃ nāmaikaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ samāptamidaṃ kapilapurāṇam
